title: Artificial intelligence pathways from weather to climate
title_zh: 从天气到气候的人工智能路径

paragraphs.en: Deep learning has made rapid advances in weather forecasting: autoregressive models trained on atmospheric reanalyses now rival dynamical models across nowcasting, medium-range, and subseasonal-to-seasonal lead times, producing well-calibrated ensemble forecasts at reduced cost. We review these advances and consider their extension to climate horizons, where the challenge shifts from initial-condition skill to producing reliable statistical responses under altered forcings. AI-powered climate prediction systems must produce credible forced responses to drivers (e.g., greenhouse gases, land-use change) typically outside the observed record. We propose two minimum requirements for AI in climate modeling: (i) external forcing agents must enter explicitly enough to support interventions in which they vary independently; and (ii) robustness must be stress-tested in out-of-distribution regimes, including extremes and counterfactual trajectories. Using leading AI autoregressive emulators and hybrid physics–AI models, we identify development and coupling challenges. Comparing the reported throughput of these models with that of GPU-ported dynamical models highlights how AI can reduce time-to-solution by advancing only the target variables at the required resolution and using longer time steps, rather than integrating a full high-frequency, multivariate state. Diverse AI downscaling strategies can partially substitute for explicit fine-scale resolution, paving the way toward inexpensive local hazard assessment across prediction horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 深度学习在天气预报领域取得了迅速进展：基于大气再分析数据训练的自回归模型如今在即时预报、中期预报以及亚季节性至季节性预报时效上已能与动力模型相媲美，并以更低的成本生成经过良好校准的集合预报。 我们回顾了这些进展，并探讨了它们向气候预测时间尺度的延伸；在这一尺度上，挑战已从初始条件的预测能力转向在改变的外强迫条件下生成可靠的统计响应。 基于人工智能的气候预测系统必须能够针对通常超出观测记录范围的驱动因素（例如温室气体、土地利用变化）生成可信的强迫响应。 我们提出了人工智能在气候建模中的两项最低要求：(i) 外部强迫智能体必须足够明确地引入，以支持那些使其独立变化的干预措施；(ii) 其稳健性必须在分布外情形下经过压力测试，包括极端情况和反事实轨迹。 通过运用领先的人工智能自回归模拟器和物理-人工智能混合模型，我们识别出了开发及耦合方面的挑战。 将这些模型报告的吞吐量与基于 GPU 的动力模型进行比较，凸显了人工智能如何能够仅以所需分辨率推进目标变量并使用更长的时间步长，而非积分完整的高频多变量状态，从而缩短求解时间。 多样化的人工智能降尺度策略可以在一定程度上替代明确的精细空间分辨率，为跨不同预测时间尺度的低成本局部灾害评估开辟了道路。

paragraphs.en: Earth system prediction is being transformed by artificial intelligence (AI), most clearly in weather forecasting. Following successes in nowcasting [ 1 , 2 ] and medium-range (up to ∼ \sim 2 weeks) forecasting [ 3 ] , data-driven models have recently begun rivaling dynamical (“physics-based”) models on subseasonal lead times of ∼ \sim 1 month when benchmarked using probabilistic scoring [ 4 , 5 ] . They produce forecasts at a fraction of the computational cost [ 6 ] , demonstrating that data-driven modeling advances can drive forecast skill, especially for problems that can be framed as a learnable mapping from a known initial state to a known future state.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变地球系统预测，其中最显著的领域是天气预报。 在短时临近预报 [ 1 , 2 ] 和中期预报（最长可达 ∼ \sim 2 周）[ 3 ] 取得成功之后，基于数据驱动的模型最近开始在概率评分法 [ 4 , 5 ] 的评估中，与动力学（“基于物理”）模型在约 ∼ \sim 1 个月的亚季节性预报时效上不相上下。 这些模型的计算成本仅为传统模型的一小部分 [ 6 ] ，这表明数据驱动建模的进步能够提升预报能力，尤其是在那些问题可以被表述为从已知初始状态到已知未来状态的可学习映射时。

sents.en: They produce forecasts at a fraction of the computational cost [ 6 ] , demonstrating that data-driven modeling advances can drive forecast skill, especially for problems that can be framed as a learnable mapping from a known initial state to a known future state.
sents.zh: 这些模型的计算成本仅为传统模型的一小部分 [ 6 ] ，这表明数据驱动建模的进步能够提升预报能力，尤其是在那些问题可以被表述为从已知初始状态到已知未来状态的可学习映射时。

paragraphs.en: This progress should not be mistaken for independence from dynamical modeling. Currently, the success of top-scoring data-driven models heavily relies on dynamical models because (i) meteorological reanalyses are used for training and evaluation [ 7 ] , (ii) initial conditions are generally provided by assimilating data into dynamical models [ 8 ] , and (iii) dynamical forecasts are often used as inputs on longer (subseasonal) timescales [ 9 ] . Even end-to-end observation-driven efforts [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] rely on observational products that embed physical modeling. If dynamical modeling deteriorates, so do the data, initial conditions, and benchmarks on which AI weather models rely. AI therefore shifts, rather than removes, the need for dynamical modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 这一进展不应被误解为与动力建模无关。 目前，高分数据驱动模型的成功在很大程度上依赖于动力模型，因为（i）气象再分析数据被用于训练和评估 [ 7 ]，（ii）初始条件通常通过将数据同化到动力模型中提供 [ 8]，以及（iii）动力预报常被用作更长（亚季节性）时间尺度上的输入 [ 9]。 即使是端到端的观测驱动方法 [ 10 , 11 , 12 ]，也依赖于包含物理建模的观测产品。 如果动力建模质量下降，那么人工智能天气模型所依赖的数据、初始条件和基准也会随之恶化。 因此，人工智能只是转移了而非消除了对动力建模的需求。

sents.en: This progress should not be mistaken for independence from dynamical modeling.
sents.zh: 这一进展不应被误解为与动力建模无关。

paragraphs.en: This dependence is paired with a fundamental limitation: AI weather models can underperform dynamical models for unprecedented, record-breaking extremes not seen during training [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . This out-of-distribution (OOD) forecasting challenge parallels the larger challenge at the heart of climate modeling. Climate projection is not simply weather forecasting extended to longer lead times. Its goal is not to predict a specific day’s weather decades ahead but to estimate how Earth system statistics change under altered boundary conditions, including changing greenhouse gases, aerosols, and land use. Yet because data for many such conditions do not yet exist, and some counterfactual conditions will never be observed, learning forced responses from observations alone appears infeasible. The gap between weather and climate is therefore wider than a difference in lead time, and wider than a simple contrast between initial- and boundary-condition prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 这种依赖关系伴随着一个根本性的局限：对于训练期间从未出现过的、破纪录的极端天气事件，AI 天气模型的表现可能不如动力学模型 [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 这种分布外（OOD）预报挑战与气候建模核心中更广泛的问题如出一辙。 气候预测并非简单地将天气预报的时间范围延长至更长的未来时段。 其目标不是预测几十年后某一天的具体天气，而是估算在改变后的边界条件下（包括温室气体、气溶胶和土地利用的变化），地球系统统计量将如何演变。 然而，由于许多此类条件的数据尚不存在，且某些反事实条件永远无法被观测到，因此仅凭观测数据来学习受强迫的响应似乎并不可行。 因此，天气与气候之间的差距不仅体现在预报时间长短的差异上，也远不止初始条件和边界条件预测之间的简单对比。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask what it takes for AI to provide accurate, well-calibrated probabilistic predictions that (i) include rare, potentially OOD events at weather timescales; and (ii) produce physically consistent counterfactual responses under unobserved forcing at climate timescales. We follow these challenges from weather to climate: how to recover event-scale spatial structure and extremes from models optimized for stable forecasts, how successful approaches and predictability evolve as prediction timescales increase, and which climate modeling and evaluation choices are required for credible forced responses. To provide concrete examples, we illustrate these steps with models the authors have helped develop, including design choices and failure modes. Throughout, we distinguish several roles that AI plays as we move across timescales: as a weather prediction system that advances Earth system states forward in time; as a component of a climate prediction system that projects Earth system responses to hitherto unobserved forcings; and as a downscaling tool that renders climate information locally actionable—each placing different demands on the underlying model.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出一个问题：人工智能需要具备哪些条件，才能提供准确且经过良好校准的概率性预测？这些预测需要（i）涵盖天气时间尺度上罕见且可能超出分布范围的事件；以及（ii）在气候时间尺度上，对未观测到的强迫因素产生物理上一致的反事实响应。 我们从天气到气候层面审视这些挑战：如何从为稳定预报而优化的模型中恢复事件尺度的空间结构和极端值；随着预测时间尺度延长，成功的方法与可预测性将如何演变；以及要获得可信的强迫响应，需要采用哪些气候建模与评估方案。 为了提供具体示例，我们将通过作者参与开发的模型来展示这些步骤，包括其中的设计选择与失效模式。 在整个过程中，随着时间尺度的变化，我们区分了人工智能所扮演的几种角色：作为能够推进地球系统状态随时间演变的天气预测系统；作为能够预测地球系统对迄今未观测到的强迫因素响应的气候预测系统组件；以及作为能将气候信息转化为地方可行动信息的降尺度工具——每种角色都对底层模型提出了不同的要求。

paragraphs.en: AI weather forecasting can be viewed as a family of conditional prediction problems: Given atmospheric information available at and before time t t , these problems can be organized around a conditional distribution p ⁡ ( x t + Δ ​ t ∣ x t , x t − Δ ​ t , … ) p(x_{t+\Delta t}\mid x_{t},x_{t-\Delta t},\ldots) of the future state given current and past information, from which a model may extract different objects: its central tendency (a single future state), samples (an ensemble of plausible futures), a conditional distribution for a derived local observable, or its gradient with respect to the inputs (a forecast sensitivity). These choices define different forecast objects, losses, sampling procedures, rollout strategies, and evaluation criteria, which strongly shape what the model learns, sometimes more so than the architecture alone [ 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: AI天气预报可被视为一系列条件预测问题：给定在时间 t 及之前可获得的大气信息，这些问题可以围绕一个条件分布 p(x_{t+\Delta t}\mid x_{t},x_{t-\Delta t},\ldots) 来组织，该分布描述了基于当前和历史信息的未来状态。模型可以从该分布中提取不同的对象：其中心趋势（单一的未来状态）、样本（一组可能的未来情景）、某个派生局部可观测量的条件分布，或者其相对于输入的梯度（预测敏感度）。 这些选择定义了不同的预测对象、损失函数、采样过程、展开策略和评估标准，这些因素强烈影响着模型的学习内容，有时甚至比模型架构本身更具影响 [16]。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic AI forecasting learns a map from the current climate-system state x t x_{t} at time t t , and often one or more past states, to a single future state. paragraphs.en: AIFS [ 8 ] , GraphCast [ 17 ] , and Pangu-Weather [ 6 ] showed that neural networks trained on meteorological analyses or reanalyses can produce stable, skillful multi-day forecasts at global scale. These systems differ substantially in their architectures—graph neural networks, Earth-specific transformers, or hybrid graph-transformer designs—yet recent design studies suggest that no single architectural family is solely responsible for forecast skill once models are expressive enough and the training pipeline is well tuned [ 18 ] . Architectures are therefore less and less of a bottleneck, and frameworks such as Anemoi [ 19 ] that make graph-based architectures easier to implement are helping the field transition from model design towards operationalization through reproducible training and evaluation pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: AIFS [ 8 ]、GraphCast [ 17 ] 和 Pangu-Weather [ 6 ] 的研究表明，基于气象分析或再分析数据训练的神经网络能够在全球尺度上生成稳定且精准的多天天气预报。 这些系统在架构上存在显著差异——包括图神经网络、针对地球的专用 Transformer 或混合图-Transformer 设计——但近期的设计研究表明，一旦模型具备足够的表达能力且训练流程经过良好调优，就没有单一的架构类别能单独决定预报的准确性 [ 18 ]。 因此，架构正逐渐不再是主要瓶颈，而像 Anemoi [ 19 ] 这类简化图基架构实现的框架，正帮助该领域从模型设计转向通过可复现的训练与评估流程实现实际应用。

paragraphs.en: The success of these models is closely tied to their optimization objective. Most deterministic systems are trained to minimize pointwise errors in future atmospheric fields. Such losses reward forecasts that place the broad circulation, fronts, and synoptic structures in approximately the right location, which is essential for medium-range skill. However, for mean-squared or mean-absolute error losses, the optimal point forecast is a conditional central tendency: the conditional mean for MSE, and the conditional median for MAE. When several sharp futures are plausible, this favors smoother forecasts, since a displaced sharp feature is penalized both where it is missing and where it is falsely predicted [ 20 ] . This smoothing can be useful for stable forecasts, but it can also suppress small-scale variance, extremes, and event-scale structure.
paragraphs.zh: 这些模型的成功与其优化目标密切相关。 大多数确定性系统都经过训练，以最小化未来大气场中的逐点误差。 这类损失函数会奖励那些能将大范围环流、锋面和天气图结构置于大致正确位置的预报，这对中期预报能力至关重要。 然而，对于均方误差或平均绝对误差损失函数，最优的点预报是一种条件中心趋势：即均方误差下的条件均值，以及平均绝对误差下的条件中位数。 当存在多种可能但差异显著的预报结果时，这类损失函数会倾向于更平滑的预报，因为一个位置偏移的尖锐特征既会在缺失处受到惩罚，也会在错误预测的位置受到惩罚 [ 20 ]。 这种平滑处理有助于生成稳定的预报，但也可能抑制小尺度变率、极端事件以及事件尺度的结构。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the loss function, forecast stride, rollout training, filtering, and multi-step fine-tuning all interact with the chaotic, scale-dependent growth of forecast error. A 6–12 h stride usually prevents models from predicting fast modes directly, while multi-step training discourages trajectories that leave the data manifold after a few autoregressive steps. These choices help stabilize longer rollouts, but they can also favor low wavenumbers and under-represent grid-scale variance [ 21 , 22 ] . Many successful deterministic pipelines therefore behave, explicitly or implicitly, like low-pass filters: AIFS uses down-/up-sampling operations [ 23 ] , FourCastNet uses spectral truncation [ 24 ] , and longer forecast strides can regularize learning in chaotic systems [ 25 ] . This trade-off is not necessarily a defect as it is one reason deterministic systems can achieve high large-scale skill and stable rollouts, with recent studies suggesting that within AI models, predictability beyond two weeks can arise when initial conditions are optimized [ 26 , 27 ] . But it certainly motivates probabilistic forecasting and targeted post-processing when the goal is risk estimation or local impact assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 除了损失函数之外，预测步长、滚动训练、过滤和多步微调都会与预测误差的混沌且依赖尺度的增长相互作用。 6–12小时的步长通常能防止模型直接预测快速模式，而多步训练则会抑制那些在几次自回归步骤后偏离数据流形的轨迹。 这些选择有助于稳定更长的滚动预测，但它们也可能偏向低波数，并导致网格尺度方差被低估 [ 21 , 22 ] 。 因此，许多成功的确定性流程无论显式还是隐式，其行为都类似于低通滤波器：AIFS使用下采样/上采样操作 [ 23 ] ，FourCastNet使用谱截断 [ 24 ] ，而更长的预测步长则能对混沌系统中的学习过程进行正则化 [ 25 ] 。 这种权衡并不一定是缺陷，因为正是这一原因使得确定性系统能够实现高的大尺度预测能力与稳定的滚动预测；近期研究指出，在AI模型中，当初始条件经过优化时，超过两周的预测能力是可能出现的 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 但如果目标是风险估计或局部影响评估，这种特性无疑会推动概率性预测和有针对性的后处理方法的应用。

This makes AI forecasting closer to operational ensemble prediction: the forecast object is not simply a best estimate, but a collection of plausible trajectories whose spread provides an estimate of forecast uncertainty.

paragraphs.en: Proper scores such as the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) avoid the central-tendency collapse of MSE/MAE losses, but they raise the challenge of multivariate calibration. Recent state-of-the-art systems differ along two axes: the objective used to train the distribution, and the mechanism used to sample from it. A first family uses fast direct ensemble generation. AIFS-CRPS [ 23 ] and FGN [ 28 ] map the atmospheric state, together with random input used to distinguish ensemble members, directly to samples from a forecast distribution. These approaches are attractive because inference is comparatively cheap: once trained, producing additional ensemble members does not require many sequential denoising or transport steps. Their main challenge is that CRPS-based objectives are often applied to calibrate the marginal distributions (normalized histogram) of variables, and sometimes of locations and lead times, independently of one another. Marginal calibration reduces the dimensionality of the problem, but it does not by itself guarantee realistic multivariate, spatial, or spectral structure, as the dependence structure across variables and locations (the copula) may remain uncalibrated.
paragraphs.zh: 像连续排名概率得分（CRPS）这样的适当评分指标可以避免MSE/MAE损失所导致的向中心值坍缩问题，但它们也带来了多变量校准的挑战。 近期的顶尖系统在两个维度上存在差异：用于训练分布的目标函数，以及从该分布中采样的机制。 第一类方法使用快速的直接集成生成方式。 AIFS-CRPS [ 23 ] 和 FGN [ 28 ] 将大气状态与用于区分集成成员的随机输入直接映射到预报分布的样本上。 这些方法之所以具有吸引力，是因为其推理过程相对成本较低：一旦训练完成，生成额外的集成成员无需经过大量顺序的去噪或传输步骤。 它们的主要挑战在于，基于CRPS的目标函数通常被用于独立校准变量的边缘分布（归一化直方图），有时还包括位置和预报时效的分布。 边缘校准降低了问题的维度，但它本身并不能保证生成逼真的多变量、空间或光谱结构，因为变量和位置之间的依赖结构（即copula）可能仍然未被校准。

sents.en: AIFS-CRPS [ 23 ] and FGN [ 28 ] map the atmospheric state, together with random input used to distinguish ensemble members, directly to samples from a forecast distribution.
sents.zh: AIFS-CRPS [ 23 ] 和 FGN [ 28 ] 将大气状态与用于区分集成成员的随机输入直接映射到预报分布的样本上。

sents.en: These approaches are attractive because inference is comparatively cheap: once trained, producing additional ensemble members does not require many sequential denoising or transport steps.
sents.zh: 这些方法之所以具有吸引力，是因为其推理过程相对成本较低：一旦训练完成，生成额外的集成成员无需经过大量顺序的去噪或传输步骤。

sents.en: Their main challenge is that CRPS-based objectives are often applied to calibrate the marginal distributions (normalized histogram) of variables, and sometimes of locations and lead times, independently of one another.
sents.zh: 它们的主要挑战在于，基于CRPS的目标函数通常被用于独立校准变量的边缘分布（归一化直方图），有时还包括位置和预报时效的分布。

sents.en: Marginal calibration reduces the dimensionality of the problem, but it does not by itself guarantee realistic multivariate, spatial, or spectral structure, as the dependence structure across variables and locations (the copula) may remain uncalibrated.
sents.zh: 边缘校准降低了问题的维度，但它本身并不能保证生成逼真的多变量、空间或光谱结构，因为变量和位置之间的依赖结构（即copula）可能仍然未被校准。

paragraphs.en: A second family uses iterative generative samplers. GenCast [ 3 ] uses diffusion-style generation to sample medium-range forecast trajectories, while ATLAS trains stochastic-interpolant and diffusion variants within the same latent transformer framework [ 29 ] . These methods define a sequence of transformations from noise or an interpolating process, usually towards the learned conditional distribution. They can produce sharp and coherent samples, but usually result in longer inference times because sampling requires multiple model evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个家族使用迭代生成采样器。 GenCast [ 3 ] 采用扩散式生成方法来采样中程预报轨迹，而 ATLAS 则在相同的潜在变换器框架内训练随机插值器和扩散变体 [ 29 ] 。 这些方法定义了一系列从噪声或插值过程开始的转换，通常朝向已学习的条件分布。 它们能够生成清晰且连贯的样本，但由于采样需要多次模型评估，通常会带来更长的推理时间。

sents.en: A second family uses iterative generative samplers.
sents.zh: 第二个家族使用迭代生成采样器。

sents.en: GenCast [ 3 ] uses diffusion-style generation to sample medium-range forecast trajectories, while ATLAS trains stochastic-interpolant and diffusion variants within the same latent transformer framework [ 29 ] .
sents.zh: GenCast [ 3 ] 采用扩散式生成方法来采样中程预报轨迹，而 ATLAS 则在相同的潜在变换器框架内训练随机插值器和扩散变体 [ 29 ] 。

sents.zh: 这些方法定义了一系列从噪声或插值过程开始的转换，通常朝向已学习的条件分布。

sents.en: They can produce sharp and coherent samples, but usually result in longer inference times because sampling requires multiple model evaluations.
sents.zh: 它们能够生成清晰且连贯的样本，但由于采样需要多次模型评估，通常会带来更长的推理时间。

paragraphs.en: These families are not strictly exclusive: Direct models can be made more structured, and iterative models can be accelerated. The design of FourCastNet3 [ 30 ] , for example, attains the spatially correlated, spectrally faithful structure usually associated with iterative samplers while retaining fast direct large-ensemble inference, combining strengths of both families within a single spherical-geometry model. ATLAS also shows that the same backbone can support stochastic interpolants, diffusion, and CRPS-based ensemble training [ 29 ] . This clarifies part of the current model landscape: probabilistic skill depends not only on whether a model is “diffusion-based” or “CRPS-trained”, but also on the latent representation, treatment of spatiotemporal spectra, conditioning history, and evaluation of the forecast multivariate state’s joint structure. Finally, probabilistic skill also depends on properties inherited from the training data. Models trained on reanalyses can, for instance, exhibit a muted or absent butterfly effect, so that small initial perturbations fail to diverge as they would under the true dynamics [ 31 ] . Such behavior traces back in part to the analyses themselves and to how initial states are estimated, which motivates examining data assimilation directly.
paragraphs.zh: 这两类模型并非严格互斥：直接模型可以构建得更结构化，而迭代模型也可以被加速。 例如，FourCastNet3 [ 30 ] 的设计实现了空间相关且光谱保真的结构——这通常是迭代采样器所具备的特性——同时保留了快速的大规模集成直接推理能力，从而在一个单球面几何模型中融合了这两类模型的优势。 ATLAS 还表明，相同的骨干网络可以支持随机插值、扩散和基于 CRPS 的集成训练 [ 29 ] 。 这澄清了当前模型格局的一部分：概率性技能不仅取决于模型是“基于扩散”的还是“基于 CRPS 训练的”，还取决于潜在表示、时空光谱的处理方式、条件历史以及对预报多变量状态联合结构的评估。 最后，概率性技能也取决于从训练数据中继承而来的特性。 例如，在再分析数据上训练的模型可能会表现出减弱甚至缺失的蝴蝶效应，导致微小的初始扰动无法像在实际动力学条件下那样发散 [ 31 ] 。 这种行为部分源于分析数据本身以及初始状态的估计方式，因此有必要直接研究数据同化问题。

paragraphs.en: Most current AI weather models still begin from an analysed atmospheric state. AI can therefore improve forecasting not only by replacing the forecast model, but also by changing how the initial state is estimated [ 10 , 12 ] . One direction keeps the data-assimilation problem recognizable, but replaces part of the inference methodology. For example, score-based data assimilation [ 32 ] uses a generative model as a prior over plausible atmospheric states and conditions it on sparse observations, which has been used to produce kilometer-scale surface analyses from weather-station data [ 33 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 目前大多数人工智能天气模型仍然从分析后的大气状态开始。 因此，人工智能不仅可以通过替换预报模型来改进预报，还可以通过改变初始状态的估计方法来实现 [ 10 , 12 ] 。 一种方法保留了数据同化问题的可识别性，但替换了部分推理方法。 例如，基于得分的数据同化方法 [ 32 ] 使用生成模型作为合理大气状态和条件的先验分布，并基于稀疏观测对其进行条件约束；该方法已被用于根据气象站数据生成千米尺度地表分析 [ 33 ] 。

sents.en: Most current AI weather models still begin from an analysed atmospheric state.
sents.zh: 目前大多数人工智能天气模型仍然从分析后的大气状态开始。

sents.en: AI can therefore improve forecasting not only by replacing the forecast model, but also by changing how the initial state is estimated [ 10 , 12 ] .
sents.zh: 因此，人工智能不仅可以通过替换预报模型来改进预报，还可以通过改变初始状态的估计方法来实现 [ 10 , 12 ] 。

sents.en: One direction keeps the data-assimilation problem recognizable, but replaces part of the inference methodology.
sents.zh: 一种方法保留了数据同化问题的可识别性，但替换了部分推理方法。

sents.en: For example, score-based data assimilation [ 32 ] uses a generative model as a prior over plausible atmospheric states and conditions it on sparse observations, which has been used to produce kilometer-scale surface analyses from weather-station data [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: 例如，基于得分的数据同化方法 [ 32 ] 使用生成模型作为合理大气状态和条件的先验分布，并基于稀疏观测对其进行条件约束；该方法已被用于根据气象站数据生成千米尺度地表分析 [ 33 ] 。

paragraphs.en: As this can become expensive for large spatial domains, a promising approach at the global scale is to perform Bayesian data assimilation in a learned latent space, where multivariate physical relationships can help spread observational information across variables and regions [ 34 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 由于对于较大的空间域而言，这种方法可能会变得成本高昂，因此在全局尺度上一种很有前景的方法是在已学习的潜在空间中执行贝叶斯数据同化，其中多变量的物理关系有助于将观测信息传播到各个变量和区域 [ 34 ]。

paragraphs.en: These two recent approaches retain the central aim of data assimilation–constructing a physically consistent initial state–but move part of the statistical estimation problem into machine-learned representations.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种近期方法保留了数据同化的核心目标——构建一个物理上一致的初始状态——但将统计估计问题的一部分转移到了机器学习表示中。

paragraphs.en: A more radical direction is to rethink the full observation-to-forecast pipeline. End-to-end observation forecasting systems such as GraphDOP [ 11 ] and Aardvark Weather [ 10 ] aim to learn directly from heterogeneous observations how to forecast variables of interest, rather than relying on a hand-designed sequence of observation operators, data assimilation, model integration, and post-processing. Instead of first mapping observations into a conventional model state, the model can learn a representation in which observables and forecast variables are directly connected.
paragraphs.zh: 一种更激进的方向是重新思考完整的从观测到预测的流程。 像 GraphDOP [ 11 ] 和 Aardvark Weather [ 10 ] 这样的端到端观测预测系统，旨在直接从异构观测中学习如何预测目标变量，而不是依赖人工设计的观测算子序列、数据同化、模型集成和后处理流程。 与其先将观测值映射到传统模型状态，模型可以直接学习一种表示方式，使可观测量和预测变量直接关联。

sents.en: A more radical direction is to rethink the full observation-to-forecast pipeline.
sents.zh: 一种更激进的方向是重新思考完整的从观测到预测的流程。

sents.en: End-to-end observation forecasting systems such as GraphDOP [ 11 ] and Aardvark Weather [ 10 ] aim to learn directly from heterogeneous observations how to forecast variables of interest, rather than relying on a hand-designed sequence of observation operators, data assimilation, model integration, and post-processing.
sents.zh: 像 GraphDOP [ 11 ] 和 Aardvark Weather [ 10 ] 这样的端到端观测预测系统，旨在直接从异构观测中学习如何预测目标变量，而不是依赖人工设计的观测算子序列、数据同化、模型集成和后处理流程。

sents.en: Instead of first mapping observations into a conventional model state, the model can learn a representation in which observables and forecast variables are directly connected.
sents.zh: 与其先将观测值映射到传统模型状态，模型可以直接学习一种表示方式，使可观测量和预测变量直接关联。

paragraphs.en: The automatic differentiability inherent to deep learning models adds another capability. Traditional tangent-linear and adjoint models have long been central to sensitivity analysis and data assimilation in numerical weather prediction [ 35 , 36 ] , but they are expensive to build and maintain for complex physics-based systems. Neural forecasters are differentiable by construction, so backpropagation can provide gradients of forecast quantities with respect to initial conditions or inputs [ 26 ] . Recent studies show that such gradients can recover physically meaningful sensitivity structures for extreme events, with large computational savings relative to traditional adjoint workflows [ 37 ] . These gradients do not remove the nonlinear limits imposed by chaotic dynamics, but they facilitate sensitivity experiments, observing-system design, and initial-condition studies.
paragraphs.zh: 深度学习模型固有的自动可微性为其增添了另一项能力。 传统的切线线性模型和伴随模型长期以来一直是数值天气预报中敏感性分析和数据同化的核心 [35, 36]，但为复杂的基于物理的系统构建和维护这些模型成本高昂。 神经预报器在结构上就是可微的，因此反向传播可以提供预报量相对于初始条件或输入的梯度 [26]。 近期的研究表明，这类梯度能够恢复极端事件具有物理意义的敏感性结构，并且与传统伴随工作流程相比能大幅节省计算资源 [37]。 这些梯度并不会消除混沌动力学所带来的非线性限制，但它们有助于开展敏感性实验、观测系统设计和初始条件研究。

paragraphs.en: Global AI forecasts are useful, but many hazards depend on scales that they do not resolve directly. A 25-30 km global forecast may capture the synoptic environment for a tropical cyclone, severe convective outbreak, or mountain precipitation event, while still missing the local wind, rainfall, or intensity structure needed for decision-making. AI approaches follow two broad strategies to fill this gap.
paragraphs.zh: 全球人工智能预报很有用，但许多灾害取决于其无法直接解析的尺度。 一个 25-30 公里分辨率的全球预报或许能捕捉到热带气旋、强对流爆发或山区降水事件的大尺度环流环境，但仍可能忽略决策所需的地方性风场、降雨或强度结构。 人工智能方法采用两种主要策略来填补这一空白。

sents.en: Global AI forecasts are useful, but many hazards depend on scales that they do not resolve directly.
sents.zh: 全球人工智能预报很有用，但许多灾害取决于其无法直接解析的尺度。

sents.en: A 25-30 km global forecast may capture the synoptic environment for a tropical cyclone, severe convective outbreak, or mountain precipitation event, while still missing the local wind, rainfall, or intensity structure needed for decision-making.
sents.zh: 一个 25-30 公里分辨率的全球预报或许能捕捉到热带气旋、强对流爆发或山区降水事件的大尺度环流环境，但仍可能忽略决策所需的地方性风场、降雨或强度结构。

sents.en: AI approaches follow two broad strategies to fill this gap.
sents.zh: 人工智能方法采用两种主要策略来填补这一空白。

paragraphs.en: The first strategy is to evolve the regional atmosphere itself. AI-based limited-area models learn regional dynamics under lateral boundary forcing, much like traditional regional numerical models but at lower inference cost [ 38 ] . Probabilistic versions such as CRPS-LAM show that regional ensemble forecasts can also be trained to optimize proper scores such as CRPS [ 39 ] . Other approaches avoid explicit lateral boundaries by using global-regional grids, such as stretched-grid models [ 40 ] or multiscale global-regional graph frameworks [ 41 ] . This strategy is appealing because it predicts regional atmospheric dynamics, but boundary treatment, rollout stability, and the cost of forecasting many high-resolution variables are limiting factors.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种策略是演化区域大气本身。 基于人工智能的区域有限域模型在侧边界强迫下学习区域动力学，这与传统的区域数值模型类似，但推理成本更低 [ 38 ] 。 概率化版本（如 CRPS-LAM）表明，区域集合预报也可以经过训练以优化 CRPS 等适当评分指标 [ 39 ] 。 其他方法通过使用全球-区域网格来避免显式的侧边界，例如拉伸网格模型 [ 40 ] 或多尺度全球-区域图框架 [ 41 ] 。 这种策略很有吸引力，因为它能够预测区域大气动力学，但边界处理、滚动稳定性以及预测大量高分辨率变量的成本是限制因素。

sents.en: The first strategy is to evolve the regional atmosphere itself.
sents.zh: 第一种策略是演化区域大气本身。

sents.en: AI-based limited-area models learn regional dynamics under lateral boundary forcing, much like traditional regional numerical models but at lower inference cost [ 38 ] .
sents.zh: 基于人工智能的区域有限域模型在侧边界强迫下学习区域动力学，这与传统的区域数值模型类似，但推理成本更低 [ 38 ] 。

sents.en: Probabilistic versions such as CRPS-LAM show that regional ensemble forecasts can also be trained to optimize proper scores such as CRPS [ 39 ] .
sents.zh: 概率化版本（如 CRPS-LAM）表明，区域集合预报也可以经过训练以优化 CRPS 等适当评分指标 [ 39 ] 。

sents.en: Other approaches avoid explicit lateral boundaries by using global-regional grids, such as stretched-grid models [ 40 ] or multiscale global-regional graph frameworks [ 41 ] .
sents.zh: 其他方法通过使用全球-区域网格来避免显式的侧边界，例如拉伸网格模型 [ 40 ] 或多尺度全球-区域图框架 [ 41 ] 。

sents.en: This strategy is appealing because it predicts regional atmospheric dynamics, but boundary treatment, rollout stability, and the cost of forecasting many high-resolution variables are limiting factors.
sents.zh: 这种策略很有吸引力，因为它能够预测区域大气动力学，但边界处理、滚动稳定性以及预测大量高分辨率变量的成本是限制因素。

paragraphs.en: The second strategy is forecast refinement: complete the coarse global forecast first, then learn a conditional distribution q θ q_{\theta} for a derived local or process-specific quantity of interest, now conditioned on the coarse forecast rather than the initial state alone,
paragraphs.zh: 第二种策略是预报优化：首先完成粗略的全局预报，然后学习一个条件分布 q θ q_{\theta}，用于描述某个派生出的局部或特定过程的感兴趣量，此时该分布的条件是粗略预报，而不仅仅是初始状态。

paragraphs.en: Here y y may be a local hazard variable, station observation, high-resolution wind field, precipitation field, or diagnostic process variable, x t init x_{t_{\mathrm{init}}} denotes knowledge of the initial state, and Z Z denotes auxiliary information such as topography, land-sea fraction, or satellite data. This formulation includes neural distributional post-processing [ 42 , 43 ] , hazard-specific post-processing, and weather downscaling. The key point is that the global model need not resolve the hazard explicitly to be useful: it may still predict the large-scale environment from which a specialized model can infer local risk.
paragraphs.zh: 此处 y y 可能是一个局部灾害变量、站点观测值、高分辨率风场、降水场或诊断过程变量；x t init x_{t_{\mathrm{init}}} 表示对初始状态的了解，而 Z Z 则表示地形、海陆比例或卫星数据等辅助信息。 该公式涵盖了神经分布后处理 [ 42 , 43 ]、针对特定灾害的后处理以及天气降尺度技术。 关键在于，全球模型无需显式解析灾害本身即可发挥作用：它仍然可以预测大尺度环境，而专门模型则能据此推断局部风险。

sents.zh: 关键在于，全球模型无需显式解析灾害本身即可发挥作用：它仍然可以预测大尺度环境，而专门模型则能据此推断局部风险。

paragraphs.en: This is already demonstrated for severe weather. Deterministic AI forecasts can contain useful information about convective environments even when convection itself is unresolved [ 44 , 45 ] . Post-processing can then specialize the prediction problem to the hazard, variable, and region of interest, as shown for convective wind gusts [ 46 ] , severe-weather probabilities [ 47 ] , and tropical-cyclone intensity [ 48 ] . Tropical cyclones are a useful test case because track, intensity, and local wind structure probe different parts of the forecast system, as illustrated in Fig. 1 for Typhoon Saola (2023). Using the TCBench benchmark [ 49 ] , we compare forecasts initialized at 12:00 UTC against reference observations from the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS; [ 50 ] ): the ensemble mean from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather “TIGGE” Forecasts [ 51 ] ; the deterministic AI forecaster Pangu-Weather [ 6 ] ; and the probabilistic AI forecaster GenCast [ 3 ] . While tracks are broadly realistic for the first few forecast days (Fig. 1 a), AI models struggle to represent intensity directly, consistent with tropical-cyclone intensity biases in ERA5, on which these models are typically trained [ 52 ] . In this setting, a lightweight distributional post-processing model recovers much of the forecasting skill for maximum wind speed (Fig. 1 b) and minimum sea-level pressure (Fig. 1 c) from the forecast 0.25 ∘ 0.25^{\circ} environment [ 48 ] , confirming it contains hazard-relevant information. Downscaling based on local observations such as synthetic-aperture-radar winds (Fig. 1 d) can complement this strategy: these observations can serve as targets for TransUNet to downscale 25-km Cross-Calibrated Multi-Platform (CCMP) ocean-surface winds for tropical cyclones by factors of 4–8, producing gap-free wind fields and reducing biases in tropical-cyclone maximum wind speed and radius of maximum wind (Fig. 1 e) [ 53 ] . Together, these examples illustrate the role of forecast refinement: the coarse, often global product provides large-scale context, while a specialized model trained on sparse but high-resolution observations reconstructs local hazard structure that the coarse model cannot directly resolve.
paragraphs.zh: 这一点在极端天气中已经得到了验证。 确定性人工智能预报即使在对流本身未被解析的情况下，也可能包含有关对流环境的有用信息 [44, 45]。 后处理可以将预测问题专门针对特定的灾害、变量和感兴趣区域进行优化，例如对对流性阵风 [46]、极端天气概率 [47] 和热带气旋强度 [48] 的预测。 热带气旋是一个很有用的测试案例，因为其路径、强度和局部风结构能够检验预报系统的不同部分，如图1中2023年台风“Saola”所示。 我们使用 TCBench 基准 [49]，将12:00 UTC初始化的预报与国际最佳路径气候管理档案库（IBTrACS；[50]）的参考观测数据进行比较：包括欧洲中期天气预报中心“TIGGE”预报的集合平均值 [51]、确定性人工智能预报模型 Pangu-Weather [6] 以及概率性人工智能预报模型 GenCast [3]。 尽管在最初的几天预报中，台风路径总体上是合理的（图1a），但人工智能模型在直接表示强度方面存在困难，这与 ERA5 数据中热带气旋强度的偏差一致，而这些模型通常是在 ERA5 数据上训练的 [52]。 在这种情况下，一个轻量级的分布后处理模型能够从0.25°×0.25°的预报环境中恢复出最大风速（图1b）和最低海平面气压（图1c）的大部分预测能力 [48]，从而证实其中包含了与灾害相关的信息。 基于局部观测（如合成孔径雷达风场，图1d）的下尺度处理可以补充这一策略：这些观测数据可以作为 TransUNet 的目标，将25公里分辨率的跨校准多平台（CCMP）海洋表面风速针对热带气旋进行4至8倍的下尺度处理，从而生成无间隙的风场，并减少热带气旋最大风速和最大风半径的偏差（图1e）[53]。 这些例子共同说明了预报精细化的作用：粗分辨率、通常是全球范围的预报产品提供了大尺度的背景信息，而一个基于稀疏但高分辨率观测数据训练的专业模型，则能够重建粗分辨率模型无法直接解析的局部灾害结构。

paragraphs.en: Foundation models test a different scaling hypothesis: broad pretraining across variables, vertical levels, datasets, and tasks may produce representations that transfer more readily than single-task forecasting systems. ClimaX [ 54 ] was an early effort to generalize this idea to weather and climate modeling by training on a combination of reanalysis and climate-model simulations, then adapting the model to tasks such as weather forecasting across lead times, downscaling to reanalysis-data resolution, and emulation of physical climate model projection. Aurora [ 55 ] and Prithvi WxC [ 56 ] extend this direction with broader atmospheric datasets and downstream tasks, including atmospheric chemistry and extreme-weather prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型检验了一种不同的扩展假设：在变量、垂直层级、数据集和任务上进行广泛的预训练，可能会产生比单一任务预测系统更容易迁移的表示。 ClimaX [ 54 ] 是一项早期的尝试，旨在通过将模型训练于再分析数据和气候模型模拟的结合数据上，然后将模型适配到不同预报时长的天气预报、向下调整至再分析数据分辨率以及模拟物理气候模型投影等任务中，从而将这一理念推广到天气和气候建模领域。 Aurora [ 55 ] 和 Prithvi WxC [ 56 ] 通过引入更广泛的大气数据集和下游任务（包括大气化学和极端天气预测），进一步拓展了这一方向。

sents.en: Aurora [ 55 ] and Prithvi WxC [ 56 ] extend this direction with broader atmospheric datasets and downstream tasks, including atmospheric chemistry and extreme-weather prediction.
sents.zh: Aurora [ 55 ] 和 Prithvi WxC [ 56 ] 通过引入更广泛的大气数据集和下游任务（包括大气化学和极端天气预测），进一步拓展了这一方向。

paragraphs.en: A central postulate is that data diversity can improve transfer when the added datasets are physically informative and sufficiently aligned with the target task. Aurora’s data-diversity experiments [ 55 ] provide indications of this: adding datasets generally improves many variables and levels, but adding poorly aligned or insufficiently trained data mixtures can also hurt some targets. Thus foundation models may help integrate reanalyses, forecasts, climate simulations, chemistry, satellite products, and eventually ocean or land data into shared representations, but they do not guarantee tail behavior, physical consistency, and robustness outside the training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心假设是，当新增的数据集在物理上具有信息量且与目标任务充分对齐时，数据多样性可以提升迁移效果。 Aurora 的数据多样性实验 [ 55 ] 为此提供了线索：添加数据集通常能改善许多变量和层级，但添加对齐度差或训练不足的混合数据也可能对某些目标产生负面影响。 因此，基础模型可能有助于将再分析、预报、气候模拟、化学、卫星产品以及最终的海域或陆地数据整合到共享表示中，但它们无法保证在训练分布之外的尾部行为、物理一致性和鲁棒性。

sents.zh: 因此，基础模型可能有助于将再分析、预报、气候模拟、化学、卫星产品以及最终的海域或陆地数据整合到共享表示中，但它们无法保证在训练分布之外的尾部行为、物理一致性和鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: For practical use, foundation-model representations may therefore still require process-specific heads or post-processing. For example, post-processing latent representations learned by foundation models is an emerging way to target variables such as evapotranspiration or precipitation [ 57 ] , where physical and statistical constraints can be imposed more directly. Future development will likely focus less on scale alone than on diverse data fusion, architecture choices, multi-resolution training, and evaluation protocols that reveal when broad pretraining improves generality and when it simply transfers biases across tasks. The forecasting problems above all sit at weather timescales; we now turn to the subseasonal-to-seasonal range, where skill increasingly depends on slowly varying components of the Earth system.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，在实际应用中，基础模型表示可能仍然需要针对特定流程的头部结构或后处理。 例如，对基础模型学习到的潜在表示进行后处理，是一种新兴的方法，可用于预测蒸散发或降水等变量 [57]，从而更直接地施加物理和统计约束。 未来的发展可能不再仅仅关注规模，而是更多地聚焦于多样化数据融合、架构选择、多分辨率训练以及能够揭示广泛预训练在何种情况下能提升泛化能力、而在何种情况下仅会在不同任务间传递偏见的评估协议。 上述所有预测问题都发生在天气时间尺度上；我们现在转向亚季节性到季节性的时间范围，在这一范围内，预测能力越来越取决于地球系统中缓慢变化的组成部分。

sents.zh: 上述所有预测问题都发生在天气时间尺度上；我们现在转向亚季节性到季节性的时间范围，在这一范围内，预测能力越来越取决于地球系统中缓慢变化的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) forecasting occupies the middle ground between weather and climate prediction. At 2–6-week lead times, forecasts remain sensitive to atmospheric initial conditions, but skill increasingly depends on slower components of the climate system, including sea-surface temperature, the upper ocean, sea ice, the stratosphere, and planetary-scale modes such as the Madden–Julian Oscillation (MJO) and the quasi-biennial oscillation. S2S forecasting therefore lies in a “predictability desert”: neither atmospheric initial conditions nor slowly varying boundary conditions provide a dominant and reliable source of skill.
paragraphs.zh: 亚季节性至季节性（S2S）预报处于天气预测和气候预测之间的中间地带。 在 2–6 周的预报提前期，预报结果仍然对大气初始条件十分敏感，但其准确性越来越取决于气候系统中变化较慢的组成部分，包括海表温度、上层海洋、海冰、平流层以及马登-朱利安振荡（MJO）和准二年振荡等行星尺度模式。 因此，S2S 预报处于一个“可预测性荒漠”之中：既非大气初始条件，也非缓慢变化的边界条件，都无法成为主导且可靠的准确性来源。

sents.zh: 亚季节性至季节性（S2S）预报处于天气预测和气候预测之间的中间地带。

paragraphs.en: What S2S forecasting shares with longer-term climate prediction is that useful forecasts are necessarily probabilistic. Once the deterministic predictability of individual atmospheric states—the first-kind predictability arising from the initial state of the atmosphere [ 58 ] —is largely exhausted, skill comes instead from shifts in the likelihood of aggregate outcomes: the probability that seasonal temperature or accumulated precipitation exceeds a given threshold. Some predictability persists through slowly varying components such as the ocean and sea ice, whose own initial states remain informative, but even this decays with lead time, and a well-calibrated forecast should then revert to the underlying climate statistics, which may themselves be nonstationary under external forcing such as global warming. S2S predictions are in this sense the shortest forecasts that share the essential character of climate predictions, and they pose a corresponding test: a model skillful at a few days may still fail to reproduce the climate statistics its long rollouts should converge to. This is the first place in our progression from weather to climate where getting the long-run distribution right becomes decisive.
paragraphs.zh: S2S 预报与长期气候预测的共同之处在于，有用的预报必然是概率性的。 一旦单个大气状态的决定论可预测性——即源于大气初始状态的第一类可预测性 [58]——基本耗尽，预报能力便转而来自总体结果可能性的变化：即季节性温度或累积降水量超过某一给定阈值的可能性。 某些可预测性会通过缓慢变化的要素（如海洋和海冰）持续存在，这些要素自身的初始状态仍具有信息价值；但即使这种可预测性也会随预报时效延长而减弱，此时一个经过良好校准的预报应回归到基础的气候统计量，而这些统计量在外部强迫（如全球变暖）下本身可能也是非平稳的。 从这个意义上说，S2S 预测是具备气候预测本质特征的最短期预报，这也带来了一个相应的检验：一个在几天预报上表现出色的模型，仍可能无法重现其长期模拟应收敛到的气候统计量。 在我们从天气向气候的演进过程中，这是首次正确把握长期分布变得至关重要。

sents.en: Some predictability persists through slowly varying components such as the ocean and sea ice, whose own initial states remain informative, but even this decays with lead time, and a well-calibrated forecast should then revert to the underlying climate statistics, which may themselves be nonstationary under external forcing such as global warming.
sents.zh: 某些可预测性会通过缓慢变化的要素（如海洋和海冰）持续存在，这些要素自身的初始状态仍具有信息价值；但即使这种可预测性也会随预报时效延长而减弱，此时一个经过良好校准的预报应回归到基础的气候统计量，而这些统计量在外部强迫（如全球变暖）下本身可能也是非平稳的。

sents.en: S2S predictions are in this sense the shortest forecasts that share the essential character of climate predictions, and they pose a corresponding test: a model skillful at a few days may still fail to reproduce the climate statistics its long rollouts should converge to.
sents.zh: 从这个意义上说，S2S 预测是具备气候预测本质特征的最短期预报，这也带来了一个相应的检验：一个在几天预报上表现出色的模型，仍可能无法重现其长期模拟应收敛到的气候统计量。

sents.en: This is the first place in our progression from weather to climate where getting the long-run distribution right becomes decisive.
sents.zh: 在我们从天气向气候的演进过程中，这是首次正确把握长期分布变得至关重要。

paragraphs.en: This makes S2S prediction a useful test for AI. Weather-trained autoregressive models can be rolled forward beyond medium range, but the processes that create memory may be implicit, incomplete, or absent when ocean, sea-ice, land, or stratospheric information is simplified. Many ML studies target individual indices or regional variables, including seasonal monsoon precipitation [ 59 ] . Here we focus on larger-state-space systems and benchmarks that test whether AI can predict broad atmospheric or Earth-system fields at S2S lead times.
paragraphs.zh: 这使得 S2S 预测成为检验人工智能的一项有效测试。 经过天气训练的自回归模型可以向前推演超过中期范围，但在海洋、海冰、陆地或平流层信息被简化的情况下，形成记忆的过程可能是隐性的、不完整的，甚至完全不存在的。 许多机器学习研究都针对单个指数或区域变量，包括季节性季风降水 [59]。 在此，我们重点关注状态空间更大的系统和基准测试，以检验人工智能是否能够在 S2S 预测时程上对广泛的大气或地球系统场进行预测。

sents.zh: 这使得 S2S 预测成为检验人工智能的一项有效测试。

sents.en: Here we focus on larger-state-space systems and benchmarks that test whether AI can predict broad atmospheric or Earth-system fields at S2S lead times.
sents.zh: 在此，我们重点关注状态空间更大的系统和基准测试，以检验人工智能是否能够在 S2S 预测时程上对广泛的大气或地球系统场进行预测。

paragraphs.en: The first S2S AI challenge, organized by the World Meteorological Organization in 2021, provided an early community benchmark by asking teams to improve probabilistic 2-m temperature and precipitation forecasts at weeks 3–4 and 5–6 relative to climatology and a recalibrated ECMWF benchmark [ 60 ] . It showed the promise of combining dynamical-model output in a data-driven fashion, but progress remained modest and underlined the need for comparison against strong bias-corrected dynamical baselines. ChaosBench developed an open S2S benchmark [ 61 ] that includes atmospheric, ocean, land, and ice variables and evaluates models from deterministic and probabilistic viewpoints. It reached a similar conclusion: models developed for weather-scale prediction lose skill rapidly at S2S lead times, often underperforming climatology after about 10 days–the point at which a forecast must earn its skill from the climate distribution rather than the initial state.
paragraphs.zh: 由世界气象组织于 2021 年举办的首届 S2S AI 挑战，通过要求各团队改进第 3–4 周和第 5–6 周的概率性 2 米温度与降水预报（相对于气候学数据和经重新校准的 ECMWF 基准）[60]，为社区提供了早期的基准。 该挑战展示了以数据驱动方式结合动力模型输出的潜力，但进展仍然有限，并凸显了与经过强偏差校正的动力基线进行比较的必要性。 ChaosBench 开发了一个开放的 S2S 基准 [61]，其中包含了大气、海洋、陆地和冰层变量，并从确定性和概率性角度对模型进行评估。 该研究得出了类似的结论：为天气尺度预测开发的模型在 S2S 预报时效下会迅速丧失能力，通常在约 10 天后表现不如气候学数据——此时预报必须从气候分布而非初始状态中获取其预测能力。

paragraphs.en: The 2025 ECMWF AI Weather Quest moves S2S benchmarking closer to an operational, real-time setting [ 62 , 4 ] . Teams submit weekly probabilistic forecasts for 2-m temperature, accumulated precipitation, and mean sea-level pressure, expressed as probabilities that quintiles of the climatological distribution will be occupied for week-3 and week-4 targets and evaluated with ranked probability skill scores. Post-processing or hybrid AI–dynamical methods have performed strongly: probabilistic bias correction builds on earlier adaptive bias-correction ideas [ 9 ] and has emerged as a strong S2S strategy when applied to both AI and dynamical forecasts [ 63 ] . Among largely data-driven systems, FuXi-S2S scored highest at the time of writing, motivating its use as our first case study.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年欧洲中期天气预报中心（ECMWF）人工智能天气竞赛使S2S基准测试更接近于实际运行中的实时环境 [ 62 , 4 ] 。 各团队每周提交概率性预报，涵盖2米温度、累积降水和平均海平面气压，以气候分布五分位数在第三周和第四周目标中出现的概率形式表达，并使用排序概率技能评分进行评估。 后处理或混合人工智能-动力模型方法表现优异：概率性偏差校正基于早期的自适应偏差校正理念 [ 9 ] ，并在同时应用于人工智能预报和动力预报时，成为一种高效的S2S策略 [ 63 ] 。 在多数以数据驱动为主的系统中，FuXi-S2S在撰写本文时得分最高，因此被选为我们的首个案例研究。

paragraphs.en: FuXi-S2S illustrates one route from weather to S2S: extend an autoregressive AI weather strategy, then modify it to represent slower predictability sources and forecast uncertainty at 2–6-week lead times [ 64 ] . The model produces global daily forecasts to 6-week lead times, covering five upper-air variables across 13 pressure levels and 11 surface variables. It is trained from ERA5 daily statistics and evaluated against ECMWF S2S reforecasts using deterministic, probabilistic, MJO, and extreme-event diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: FuXi-S2S 展示了从天气预测到 S2S 的一种方法：首先扩展一种自回归 AI 天气策略，然后对其进行修改，以表示在 2–6 周预测期内的较慢可预测性来源和预报不确定性 [ 64 ]。 该模型能够生成全球每日预报，预测期最长可达 6 周，涵盖 13 个压力层上的五个上层大气变量以及 11 个地表变量。 该模型基于 ERA5 的每日统计数据训练，并通过确定性诊断、概率性诊断、MJO 诊断和极端事件诊断，与 ECMWF S2S 重预报进行对比评估。

sents.en: FuXi-S2S illustrates one route from weather to S2S: extend an autoregressive AI weather strategy, then modify it to represent slower predictability sources and forecast uncertainty at 2–6-week lead times [ 64 ] .
sents.zh: FuXi-S2S 展示了从天气预测到 S2S 的一种方法：首先扩展一种自回归 AI 天气策略，然后对其进行修改，以表示在 2–6 周预测期内的较慢可预测性来源和预报不确定性 [ 64 ]。

sents.zh: 该模型能够生成全球每日预报，预测期最长可达 6 周，涵盖 13 个压力层上的五个上层大气变量以及 11 个地表变量。

sents.en: It is trained from ERA5 daily statistics and evaluated against ECMWF S2S reforecasts using deterministic, probabilistic, MJO, and extreme-event diagnostics.
sents.zh: 该模型基于 ERA5 的每日统计数据训练，并通过确定性诊断、概率性诊断、MJO 诊断和极端事件诊断，与 ECMWF S2S 重预报进行对比评估。

paragraphs.en: The key methodological change is not simply a longer rollout. FuXi-S2S adds a perturbation module that injects flow-dependent perturbations into the model’s latent space. This differs from conventional ensemble construction, where uncertainty is often represented through perturbations to the initial state. In FuXi-S2S, hidden-state perturbations are learned from historical data and sampled during inference, allowing the model to generate large ensembles efficiently while maintaining forecast spread. This avoids collapsing toward a single trajectory as deterministic predictability decays. The perturbation module is central to its improved probabilistic skill and to its performance relative to ECMWF S2S for variables such as total precipitation and outgoing longwave radiation [ 64 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 关键的方法论变化并不仅仅是更长的滚动预测。 FuXi-S2S 增加了一个扰动模块，该模块将依赖于流场的扰动注入模型的潜在空间。 这与传统的集成构建方法不同，在后者中，不确定性通常通过初始状态的扰动来表示。 在 FuXi-S2S 中，隐藏状态的扰动是从历史数据中学习并在推理过程中采样的，这使得模型能够在保持预报离散度的同时高效地生成大规模集成。 这样就能避免在确定性可预测性下降时向单一轨迹坍缩。 该扰动模块是其概率技能提升以及相对于 ECMWF S2S 在总降水量和出射长波辐射等变量上表现改善的核心 [ 64 ]。

paragraphs.en: FuXi-S2S also improves the representation of low-frequency modes that carry S2S predictability. Its most prominent result is for the MJO, where skillful prediction is extended from about 30 to 36 days. The model better maintains MJO amplitude and phase and captures realistic MJO teleconnections, which helps explain its improved global precipitation skill. This suggests that an autoregressive AI model trained on atmospheric fields can learn part of the organized tropical variability that links initial conditions, slowly varying boundary conditions, and extratropical predictability at S2S lead times.
paragraphs.zh: FuXi-S2S 还改进了承载 S2S 可预测性的低频模态的表示。 其最显著的成果体现在 MJO 上，预测能力从大约 30 天延长到了 36 天。 该模型能更好地维持 MJO 的振幅和相位，并捕捉到真实的 MJO 遥相关关系，这有助于解释其全球降水预测能力的提升。 这表明，在大气场数据上训练的自回归 AI 模型能够学习部分有组织的热带变率，这些变率将初始条件、缓慢变化的边界条件以及 S2S 预报时长的外带可预测性联系起来。

paragraphs.en: In its 2022 Pakistan floods case study, FuXi-S2S predicted extreme rainfall anomalies earlier than ECMWF S2S. The authors then used backpropagation of a custom precipitation-anomaly loss to generate saliency maps with respect to sea-surface temperature. These maps highlighted precursor patterns in the tropical central Pacific and western Indian Ocean, consistent with known physical drivers of the event and reassuring from a mechanism perspective.
paragraphs.zh: 在 2022 年巴基斯坦洪水的案例研究中，FuXi-S2S 比 ECMWF S2S 更早预测到了极端降雨异常。 随后，作者通过反向传播一个自定义的降水异常损失函数，生成了与海表温度相关的显著性图。 这些地图凸显了热带中太平洋和印度洋西部的前兆模式，这与该事件已知的物理驱动因素一致，从机制角度来看也令人信服。

paragraphs.en: Instead of extending an AI weather model toward longer lead times, CliMA starts from a hybrid climate-modeling philosophy and uses S2S prediction as an objective development test. CliMA retains a physics-based dynamical core for the resolved climate system while adding data-driven components for selected parts of the modeling pipeline [ 65 ] : data-driven closure models for source and sink terms within parameterizations, AI flux corrections for aggregate subgrid fluxes, offline post-processing and bias correction of model output against observations, and emulators mapping uncertain parameters to model diagnostics for uncertainty quantification.
paragraphs.zh: 与将人工智能天气模型扩展到更长的预测时间不同，CliMA 采用混合气候建模理念，并使用 S2S 预测作为客观的发展测试。 CliMA 保留了用于解析气候系统的基于物理的动力核心，同时为建模流程的特定部分添加了数据驱动组件 [65]：参数化方案中源项和汇项的数据驱动闭合模型、针对聚合子网格通量的人工智能通量修正、模型输出与观测数据的离线后处理和偏差校正，以及将不确定参数映射到模型诊断指标以进行不确定性量化的模拟器。

sents.zh: CliMA 保留了用于解析气候系统的基于物理的动力核心，同时为建模流程的特定部分添加了数据驱动组件 [65]：参数化方案中源项和汇项的数据驱动闭合模型、针对聚合子网格通量的人工智能通量修正、模型输出与观测数据的离线后处理和偏差校正，以及将不确定参数映射到模型诊断指标以进行不确定性量化的模拟器。

paragraphs.en: This makes S2S evaluation useful in a different way from FuXi-S2S: it provides a more direct test of short-time climate dynamics than time-mean climate statistics alone. To achieve CliMA’s flagship AMIP setup, the atmosphere model was developed and evaluated using seasonal-to-subseasonal runs of roughly 40 days or less, including through participation in the AI Weather Quest. The S2S and climate-development objectives overlap for several core variables: mean sea-level pressure, 2-m temperature, surface precipitation, and geopotential height. A representative week-3 forecast from “CliMA-S2S”, the CliMA coupled land–atmosphere model with postprocessing, is shown in Fig. 2 following a 9 July 1997 initialization. Starting from a single deterministic coupled-model trajectory, lightweight distributional post-processing corrects systematic forecast biases and estimates predictive uncertainty from ERA5-based calibration statistics, rather than from an ensemble of perturbed initial conditions. The resulting probabilistic forecasts capture the large-scale structure seen in ERA5 for 300-hPa geopotential height and 2-m temperature and yield positive probabilistic skill relative to climatology. Beyond these forecast variables, climate-model development uses process-specific diagnostics evaluated against observational products, including liquid water path against MAC-LWP over ocean [ 66 ] , top-of-atmosphere cloud radiative effects against CERES [ 67 ] , and three-dimensional cloud fraction against CloudSat/CALIPSO [ 68 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这使得 S2S 评估在用途上与 FuXi-S2S 有所不同：与仅依赖时间平均气候统计量相比，它能更直接地检验短期气候动力学过程。 为实现 CliMA 的核心 AMIP 设置，大气模型的开发和评估采用了持续约 40 天或更短的季节至亚季节性运行，其中包括参与“AI 天气挑战”活动。 S2S 和气候发展目标在几个核心变量上存在重叠：平均海平面气压、2 米温度、地表降水和地势高度。 “CliMA-S2S”（经过后处理的 CliMA 耦合陆-大气模型）的一个代表性第 3 周预报结果展示于图 2 中，该预报基于 1997 年 7 月 9 日的初始化运行。 从单条确定性耦合模型轨迹出发，轻量化的分布后处理方法利用基于 ERA5 的校准统计量来修正系统性预报偏差并估计预测不确定性，而非依赖扰动初始条件的集合。 由此产生的概率性预报能够捕捉到 ERA5 中观测到的 300 hPa 地势高度和 2 米温度的大尺度结构，并且相对于气候学基准展现出积极的概率技能。 除了这些预报变量外，气候模型开发还使用针对特定物理过程的诊断指标，并与观测产品进行对比评估，包括海洋区域液态水路径与 MAC-LWP 的对比 [66]、大气顶云辐射效应与 CERES 的对比 [67]，以及三维云量与 CloudSat/CALIPSO 的对比 [68]。

sents.en: This makes S2S evaluation useful in a different way from FuXi-S2S: it provides a more direct test of short-time climate dynamics than time-mean climate statistics alone.
sents.zh: 这使得 S2S 评估在用途上与 FuXi-S2S 有所不同：与仅依赖时间平均气候统计量相比，它能更直接地检验短期气候动力学过程。

sents.en: To achieve CliMA’s flagship AMIP setup, the atmosphere model was developed and evaluated using seasonal-to-subseasonal runs of roughly 40 days or less, including through participation in the AI Weather Quest.

paragraphs.en: The Weather Quest setting exposed concrete axes of improvement for climate-model development. First, stratospheric circulation biases motivated changes to the model top and sponge-layer treatment. Second, sea-ice initialization mattered: initializing only with a constant freezing condition, rather than a two-dimensional sea-ice state, produced polar 2-m temperature and mean-sea-level-pressure biases that persisted beyond the first forecast week. Third, gravity-wave treatment produced biases visible within a week in surface pressure and in stratospheric and upper-tropospheric momentum, with effects that also persisted beyond the first week. Many of the resulting choices were retained in later coupled CliMA configurations because they improved model behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 《天气任务》这一设定揭示了气候模型开发中需要改进的关键方向。 首先，平流层环流的偏差促使了对模型顶部和海绵层处理方式的调整。 其次，海冰初始化至关重要：仅使用恒定冻结条件进行初始化（而非二维海冰状态），会导致极区 2 米温度和平均海平面气压出现偏差，且这些偏差会持续超过首个预报周。 第三，重力波处理方式在首周内便会在地表气压以及平流层和上对流层的动量中引发可见偏差，其影响同样会延续至第一周之后。 由于这些选择能够改善模型表现，其中许多方案被保留在了后续耦合的 CliMA 配置中。

paragraphs.en: This highlights why S2S can be valuable for developing climate models. Climate-model calibration is often an inverse problem: parameters are adjusted so that long-run conditional statistics, such as cloud or radiation metrics, match observations despite internal variability. While S2S weekly forecasts are too noisy and initial-condition dependent for fully learning some fields, such as precipitation, they can still be informative for smoother fields such as mean sea-level pressure. This tension between short-range forecast signals and the long-run statistics one ultimately wants to constrain recurs throughout climate modeling, and we return to it when discussing how models should be selected and evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 这凸显了 S2S 在开发气候模型方面的价值。 气候模型的校准通常是一个反问题：需要调整参数，使得长期条件统计量（例如云或辐射指标）能够与观测数据相匹配，尽管存在内部变异性。 虽然 S2S 的每周预报噪声过大且过于依赖初始条件，无法完全学习某些场（如降水），但它们对于更平滑的场（如平均海平面气压）仍然具有参考价值。 短期预报信号与最终希望约束的长期统计量之间的这种矛盾贯穿整个气候建模过程，在讨论模型的选择和评估方法时，我们还会再次探讨这一问题。

paragraphs.en: The central question in moving from weather to climate modeling is not only whether an AI model can sustain long rollouts, but whether it can produce reliable responses to unseen, time-dependent forcings. For climate projection, different modeling strategies must ultimately address three coupled questions. First, how will climate—including clouds, circulation and extreme events—change as greenhouse gases such as CO 2 and CH 4 rise? Second, how will aerosol-emission changes affect climate through direct radiative effects and indirect effects on cloud formation? Third, how will carbon-cycle feedbacks partition emitted CO 2 among the atmosphere, land biosphere, and ocean? The expected output is the temporal evolution of spatially resolved physical fields, from which equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS), transient climate response (TCR), and transient climate response to cumulative carbon emissions (TCRE) can be derived.
paragraphs.zh: 从天气建模转向气候建模的核心问题，不仅在于人工智能模型能否维持长时间运行，更在于它能否对未知且随时间变化的强迫因素产生可靠的响应。 对于气候预测而言，不同的建模策略最终必须解决三个相互耦合的问题。 首先，随着二氧化碳（CO₂）和甲烷（CH₄）等温室气体浓度上升，气候——包括云层、大气环流和极端天气事件——将发生怎样的变化？ 其次，气溶胶排放的变化将通过直接辐射效应以及对云形成的间接影响，如何作用于气候？ 第三，碳循环反馈机制将如何分配已排放的二氧化碳到大气层、陆地生物圈和海洋中？ 预期的输出是空间分辨物理场随时间的演化过程，由此可以推导出平衡气候敏感度（ECS）、瞬态气候响应（TCR）以及对累积碳排放的瞬态气候响应（TCRE）。

paragraphs.en: Climate attribution also requires counterfactual historical scenarios, such as the climate had greenhouse-gas concentrations not increased. Such counterfactuals are embodied in the Coupled Model Intercomparison Project scenario sets, including ScenarioMIP for CMIP6 [ 69 , 70 ] and CMIP7 [ 71 ] . How to produce them causally remains an open question. Direct causal-emulation strategies are emerging, exemplified by PICABU [ 72 ] , which constrains each grid cell to depend on a single latent climate mode and learns sparse lagged links among these modes, enabling targeted intervention experiments and counterfactuals. More generally, relevant forcing agents must be independently manipulable; representing them explicitly through physically-informed pathways is one way to achieve this. Let φ ( i ) \varphi^{(i)} denote the prognostic state of realization i i , where realizations may differ in their forcing trajectories or initial conditions:
paragraphs.zh: 气候归因还需要反事实的历史情景，例如温室气体浓度未增加时的气候状况。 这类反事实情景体现在耦合模型互比较项目的情景集合中，包括用于 CMIP6 的 ScenarioMIP [ 69 , 70 ] 以及 CMIP7 [ 71 ] 。 如何以因果方式生成这些情景仍然是一个开放问题。 直接的因果模拟策略正在出现，例如 PICABU [ 72 ] ，它将每个网格单元限制为仅依赖于单一的潜在气候模式，并学习这些模式之间的稀疏滞后联系，从而支持有针对性的干预实验和反事实分析。 更普遍地说，相关的强迫智能体必须能够被独立操控；通过物理信息明确的途径对其显式表示是实现这一目标的方法之一。 令 φ ( i ) \varphi^{(i)} 表示实现 i 的预测状态，其中不同实现的强迫轨迹或初始条件可能有所不同：

paragraphs.en: Anthropogenic and natural forcing agents, including greenhouse gases and aerosols, affect climate primarily through radiative heating, which contributes directly to temperature tendencies in the atmosphere and the surface layers of land and ocean. A minimal causal requirement is therefore that relevant agents enter as explicit, independently manipulable inputs whose effects remain identifiable when varied separately. Fig. 3 illustrates one way to make these pathways explicit, while autoregressive AI models with time steps of six hours or more may instead mix radiative heating with other processes within a learned update. In concentration-driven configurations, greenhouse-gas and aerosol concentrations can be prescribed; emissions-driven Earth system models must instead predict them by representing atmospheric chemistry and land and ocean biogeochemistry.
paragraphs.zh: 人为和自然强迫智能体，包括温室气体和气溶胶，主要通过辐射加热影响气候，而辐射加热会直接导致大气层以及陆地和海洋表层温度的变化趋势。 因此，一个最基本的因果要求是：相关的智能体必须作为明确且可独立操控的输入项出现，当这些输入项被单独改变时，其效应仍然可以被识别。 图 3 展示了一种使这些路径显性化的方法；而时间步长为六小时或更长的自回归人工智能模型，则可能会将辐射加热与其他过程混合在已学习的更新机制中。 在由浓度驱动的配置中，温室气体和气溶胶的浓度可以被预先设定；而在由排放驱动的地球系统模型中，则必须通过模拟大气化学以及陆地和海洋的生物地球化学来预测这些浓度。

paragraphs.en: Earth system processes span overlapping timescales. Long-lived greenhouse gases exert small but persistent radiative perturbations that slowly modify weather and internal climate variability, whereas aerosol–cloud interactions and cloud feedbacks can evolve on weather timescales. Learned updates may capture such interactions [ 73 ] , but slow ocean and atmospheric-composition feedbacks extend into climate states without recent historical analogues. Land- and water-use changes similarly act through slowly evolving boundary conditions and changes in surface albedo, roughness, soil moisture, and energy and water fluxes.
paragraphs.zh: 地球系统过程跨越相互重叠的时间尺度。 寿命长的温室气体会产生微小但持续存在的辐射扰动，从而缓慢改变天气和内部气候变率；而气溶胶-云相互作用和云反馈则可能在天气时间尺度上发生演变。 学习得到的更新或许能够捕捉到这类相互作用 [ 73 ] ，但海洋和大气成分反馈的缓慢变化会延伸至缺乏近期历史对应状态的气候状态中。 土地和水资源利用的变化同样通过缓慢演变的边界条件以及地表反照率、粗糙度、土壤湿度和能量与水分通量的变化来发挥作用。

sents.en: Earth system processes span overlapping timescales.
sents.zh: 地球系统过程跨越相互重叠的时间尺度。

sents.en: Long-lived greenhouse gases exert small but persistent radiative perturbations that slowly modify weather and internal climate variability, whereas aerosol–cloud interactions and cloud feedbacks can evolve on weather timescales.
sents.zh: 寿命长的温室气体会产生微小但持续存在的辐射扰动，从而缓慢改变天气和内部气候变率；而气溶胶-云相互作用和云反馈则可能在天气时间尺度上发生演变。

sents.en: Learned updates may capture such interactions [ 73 ] , but slow ocean and atmospheric-composition feedbacks extend into climate states without recent historical analogues.
sents.zh: 学习得到的更新或许能够捕捉到这类相互作用 [ 73 ] ，但海洋和大气成分反馈的缓慢变化会延伸至缺乏近期历史对应状态的气候状态中。

sents.en: Land- and water-use changes similarly act through slowly evolving boundary conditions and changes in surface albedo, roughness, soil moisture, and energy and water fluxes.
sents.zh: 土地和水资源利用的变化同样通过缓慢演变的边界条件以及地表反照率、粗糙度、土壤湿度和能量与水分通量的变化来发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Two broad modeling strategies follow: Autoregressive pure AI models learn most of a component (e.g. the full atmosphere or ocean) or coupled-system update operator. Such pure AI models can be used to efficiently emulate reference physical model trajectories. Climate emulators vary in complexity [ 74 ] ; we here focus on emulators that represent spatially resolved climate fields, simulate weather-scale variability, and could support future AI Earth system models [ 75 ] . Hybrid AI–physics models prescribe physical equations for processes such as resolved fluid dynamics and radiative transfer while learning unresolved or uncertain processes from data, particularly subgrid-scale parameterizations [ 76 , 77 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 接下来有两种主要的建模策略：自回归纯人工智能模型学习某个组件（例如完整的大气或海洋）的大部分特征，或者学习耦合系统的更新算子。 这类纯人工智能模型可用于高效模拟参考物理模型的轨迹。 气候模拟器的复杂程度各不相同 [ 74 ]；此处我们重点关注能够表示空间分辨的气候场、模拟天气尺度变异性，并可能支持未来人工智能地球系统模型的模拟器 [ 75 ]。 混合人工智能-物理模型为已解析的流体动力学和辐射传输等过程指定物理方程，同时从数据中学习未解析或不确定的过程，特别是亚网格尺度参数化方法 [ 76 , 77 ]。

paragraphs.en: Both strategies are limited by the scarcity of observed forced responses. The historical record contains one realization of the slow forced response, with forcing agents covarying, so pure AI models trained on observations or reanalyses may learn correlations that fail in counterfactual climates. Controlled simulations can broaden emulator training and enable direct OOD tests against held-out reference-model simulations, but such tests establish fidelity to the reference, not to Earth. Physically based models likewise cannot be verified against unobserved climates, and their responses remain uncertain, as illustrated by the CMIP6 spread in ECS [ 78 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这两种策略都受到可观测到的强迫响应稀缺性的限制。 历史记录包含缓慢强迫响应的一个实现，其中强迫智能体是协变的，因此基于观测或再分析数据训练的纯人工智能模型可能会学到在反事实气候中失效的相关性。 受控模拟可以扩展模拟器的训练范围，并允许针对预留的参考模型模拟进行直接的域外测试，但这类测试只能验证与参考模型的一致性，而非与地球实际气候的一致性。 基于物理的模型同样无法通过未观测到的气候进行验证，其响应仍然不确定，正如 CMIP6 中 ECS 的离散度所显示的 [78]。

paragraphs.en: Most current AI emulators represent fewer processes than mature Earth system models. Emissions-driven simulations require interactive carbon-cycle and atmospheric-composition processes, including land and ocean biogeochemistry, atmospheric chemistry, and aerosol processes. Replacing components within mature models offers hybrid AI-physics models a near-term route to participation in CMIP7, while coupled emulators need to incorporate additional components. Development of AI emulators should therefore complement continued development of process-based climate and Earth system models as both strategies mutually benefit each other. Beyond these strategies, AI can be combined with observations to refine estimates of variables such as effective radiative forcing [ 79 ] , and to design controlling-factor analyses that hold across climates [ 80 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 目前大多数人工智能模拟器所模拟的过程数量少于成熟的地球系统模型。 以排放为驱动力的模拟需要交互式碳循环和大气成分过程，包括陆地和海洋生物地球化学、大气化学以及气溶胶过程。 在成熟模型中替换组件为混合人工智能-物理模型提供了短期内参与 CMIP7 的可行路径，而耦合模拟器则需要整合更多组件。 因此，人工智能模拟器的开发应当与基于过程的气候和地球系统模型的持续开发相辅相成，因为这两种策略能相互促进。 除了这些策略外，人工智能还可以与观测数据结合，以优化有效辐射强迫等变量的估计值 [79]，并设计适用于不同气候条件的控制因子分析方法 [80]。

sents.zh: 目前大多数人工智能模拟器所模拟的过程数量少于成熟的地球系统模型。

sents.zh: 除了这些策略外，人工智能还可以与观测数据结合，以优化有效辐射强迫等变量的估计值 [79]，并设计适用于不同气候条件的控制因子分析方法 [80]。

paragraphs.en: The development of AI climate models requires evaluation beyond short-range forecast accuracy. Indeed, most autoregressive AI climate models are optimized using weather-prediction losses over lead times of a few days, whereas climate performance is defined based on statistics from multi-year or multidecadal simulations [ 81 ] . Lower short-range forecast error does therefore not guarantee smaller climate bias or a more accurate forced response, and long-rollout diagnostics and climate statistics must therefore be included in model selection and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能气候模型的开发需要超越短期预报准确性的评估。 事实上，大多数自回归式人工智能气候模型都是基于几天预报时长的天气预测损失函数进行优化的，而气候性能则是根据多年或数十年模拟的统计数据来定义的 [81]。 因此，较低的短期预报误差并不一定意味着更小的气候偏差或更准确的强迫响应，所以必须将长期运行诊断和气候统计纳入模型的选择与评估中。

sents.en: The development of AI climate models requires evaluation beyond short-range forecast accuracy.
sents.zh: 人工智能气候模型的开发需要超越短期预报准确性的评估。

paragraphs.en: ClimateBench provided an early benchmark for emulating global and spatially resolved forced climate responses from prescribed emissions and concentrations [ 82 ] . AIMIP extends this effort to temporally-resolved atmospheric models that explicitly generate weather variability. Its first phase establishes a common AMIP-style framework, output format, and training constraints for evaluating AI weather and climate models as atmospheric climate models [ 75 ] .
paragraphs.zh: ClimateBench 为模拟基于预设排放和浓度的全球及空间分辨的强迫气候响应提供了早期的基准 [ 82 ] 。 AIMIP 将这项工作扩展到能够显式生成天气变化的时间分辨大气模型。 其第一阶段建立了一个通用的 AMIP 风格框架、输出格式以及训练约束，用于评估人工智能天气和气候模型作为大气气候模型的性能 [ 75 ] 。

sents.en: ClimateBench provided an early benchmark for emulating global and spatially resolved forced climate responses from prescribed emissions and concentrations [ 82 ] .
sents.zh: ClimateBench 为模拟基于预设排放和浓度的全球及空间分辨的强迫气候响应提供了早期的基准 [ 82 ] 。

sents.en: AIMIP extends this effort to temporally-resolved atmospheric models that explicitly generate weather variability.
sents.zh: AIMIP 将这项工作扩展到能够显式生成天气变化的时间分辨大气模型。

sents.en: Its first phase establishes a common AMIP-style framework, output format, and training constraints for evaluating AI weather and climate models as atmospheric climate models [ 75 ] .
sents.zh: 其第一阶段建立了一个通用的 AMIP 风格框架、输出格式以及训练约束，用于评估人工智能天气和气候模型作为大气气候模型的性能 [ 75 ] 。

paragraphs.en: AIMIP Phase 1 models simulate the atmosphere over 1979–2024 under prescribed historical sea-surface temperatures. The evaluation considers mean-climate biases, historical trends, atmospheric responses to El Niño-related sea-surface-temperature anomalies, temporal variability, and OOD generalization. The common outputs are provided in CMIP-compatible formats, allowing the wider climate-modeling community to apply established process-oriented and regional diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: AIMIP 第一阶段模型在预设的历史海表温度条件下，模拟了 1979–2024 年期间的大气状况。 评估涵盖了平均气候偏差、历史趋势、大气对厄尔尼诺相关海表温度异常的响应、时间变异性以及 OOD 泛化能力。 通用输出以与 CMIP 兼容的格式提供，使更广泛的气候建模社区能够应用成熟的流程导向和区域诊断方法。

sents.en: AIMIP Phase 1 models simulate the atmosphere over 1979–2024 under prescribed historical sea-surface temperatures.
sents.zh: AIMIP 第一阶段模型在预设的历史海表温度条件下，模拟了 1979–2024 年期间的大气状况。

sents.en: The evaluation considers mean-climate biases, historical trends, atmospheric responses to El Niño-related sea-surface-temperature anomalies, temporal variability, and OOD generalization.
sents.zh: 评估涵盖了平均气候偏差、历史趋势、大气对厄尔尼诺相关海表温度异常的响应、时间变异性以及 OOD 泛化能力。

sents.en: The common outputs are provided in CMIP-compatible formats, allowing the wider climate-modeling community to apply established process-oriented and regional diagnostics.
sents.zh: 通用输出以与 CMIP 兼容的格式提供，使更广泛的气候建模社区能够应用成熟的流程导向和区域诊断方法。

paragraphs.en: The first results show that several AI models reproduce major features of the historical atmosphere and its response to prescribed El Niño variability. However, some models underestimate historical warming trends, and model responses diverge in OOD experiments, including spatially uniform sea-surface-temperature perturbations [ 75 ] . Historical AMIP performance is therefore a necessary but insufficient test of climate-model credibility. Models must also respond appropriately to boundary conditions and external forcings outside the training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 初步结果表明，多个人工智能模型能够再现历史大气及其对预设厄尔尼诺变异性响应的关键特征。 然而，某些模型低估了历史上的变暖趋势，并且在分布外（OOD）实验中，模型的响应出现分歧，包括空间上均匀的海面温度扰动 [ 75 ] 。 因此，历史 AMIP 表现是对气候模型可信度进行检验的必要但不足的条件。 模型还必须能够恰当响应训练分布之外的边界条件和外部强迫。

sents.en: The first results show that several AI models reproduce major features of the historical atmosphere and its response to prescribed El Niño variability.
sents.zh: 初步结果表明，多个人工智能模型能够再现历史大气及其对预设厄尔尼诺变异性响应的关键特征。

sents.en: However, some models underestimate historical warming trends, and model responses diverge in OOD experiments, including spatially uniform sea-surface-temperature perturbations [ 75 ] .
sents.zh: 然而，某些模型低估了历史上的变暖趋势，并且在分布外（OOD）实验中，模型的响应出现分歧，包括空间上均匀的海面温度扰动 [ 75 ] 。

sents.en: Historical AMIP performance is therefore a necessary but insufficient test of climate-model credibility.
sents.zh: 因此，历史 AMIP 表现是对气候模型可信度进行检验的必要但不足的条件。

sents.en: Models must also respond appropriately to boundary conditions and external forcings outside the training distribution.
sents.zh: 模型还必须能够恰当响应训练分布之外的边界条件和外部强迫。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, AIMIP, ClimateBench, and broader Earth system AI benchmarking efforts within the AICMIP umbrella [ 83 ] , complement but do not replace the experimental hierarchy being developed for CMIP7. Future evaluation should build upon the measures of mean climate, internal variability, trends, extremes, and transient responses to prescribed forcing that they established. In particular, assessments of top-of-atmosphere and atmospheric energy budgets, atmospheric and oceanic mass and water budgets, and emergent diagnostics such as evaporation minus precipitation would be valuable, especially in the context of models coupling multiple Earth system components together. Depending on model scope, forced-response tests should include the sign and magnitude of ECS, TCR, and TCRE.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，AIMIP、ClimateBench 以及 AICMIP 框架下的更广泛地球系统人工智能基准测试工作 [83]，是对 CMIP7 正在发展的实验层级结构的补充，但并不能取代它。 未来的评估应基于他们已确立的指标，包括平均气候、内部变异性、趋势、极端事件以及对指定强迫的瞬态响应。 特别地，对大气顶和大气能量收支、大气和海洋质量与水量收支，以及诸如蒸发减去降水等新兴诊断指标的评估将很有价值，尤其是在模型耦合了多个地球系统组件的情况下。 根据模型的覆盖范围，强迫响应测试应包含 ECS、TCR 和 TCRE 的符号与大小。

sents.en: Therefore, AIMIP, ClimateBench, and broader Earth system AI benchmarking efforts within the AICMIP umbrella [ 83 ] , complement but do not replace the experimental hierarchy being developed for CMIP7.
sents.zh: 因此，AIMIP、ClimateBench 以及 AICMIP 框架下的更广泛地球系统人工智能基准测试工作 [83]，是对 CMIP7 正在发展的实验层级结构的补充，但并不能取代它。

sents.zh: 未来的评估应基于他们已确立的指标，包括平均气候、内部变异性、趋势、极端事件以及对指定强迫的瞬态响应。

sents.en: In particular, assessments of top-of-atmosphere and atmospheric energy budgets, atmospheric and oceanic mass and water budgets, and emergent diagnostics such as evaporation minus precipitation would be valuable, especially in the context of models coupling multiple Earth system components together.
sents.zh: 特别地，对大气顶和大气能量收支、大气和海洋质量与水量收支，以及诸如蒸发减去降水等新兴诊断指标的评估将很有价值，尤其是在模型耦合了多个地球系统组件的情况下。

sents.zh: 根据模型的覆盖范围，强迫响应测试应包含 ECS、TCR 和 TCRE 的符号与大小。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid atmospheric models typically retain a dynamical core while augmenting selected processes with data-driven components. For instance, the Neural General Circulation Model (GCM) combines a fully differentiable atmospheric dynamical core with learned parameterizations [ 84 ] , allowing direct training against satellite observations for variables such as precipitation, whose diurnal statistics remain challenging to model in conventional GCMs [ 85 ] . The ML-enhanced (MLe) version of ICON-A confirmed the advantages of data-driven equation discovery for parameterization [ 86 ] , provided that the learned parameterization is jointly recalibrated with existing ones, improving agreement with observations of the target process after recalibration [ 87 ] . Data-driven ocean closures for hybrid modeling now span the full complexity spectrum, including physics-informed and scale-aware models, facilitating the broader goal of coupled atmosphere–ocean–sea-ice hybrid simulations [ 88 ] . Related approaches are surveyed in the HybridESM living review [ 89 ] ; we henceforth focus on the Climate Modeling Alliance (CliMA) as it provides a comprehensive example of hybrid climate modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 混合大气模型通常保留一个动力学核心，同时用数据驱动组件增强选定的过程。 例如，神经通用环流模型（GCM）将完全可微分的大气动力学核心与学习得到的参数化方法相结合 [ 84 ] ，从而可以直接利用卫星观测数据对降水等变量进行训练，而这些变量的日变化统计特征在传统 GCM 中仍然难以建模 [ 85 ] 。 ICON-A 的机器学习增强版（MLe）证实了数据驱动方程发现方法在参数化方面的优势 [ 86 ] ，前提是学习得到的参数化方法需与现有参数化方法共同重新校准，这样在校准后就能更好地与目标过程的观测结果一致 [ 87 ] 。 用于混合建模的数据驱动海洋闭合方法如今已覆盖完整的复杂性谱，包括基于物理和尺度感知的模型，从而促进了大气–海洋–海冰耦合混合模拟这一更广泛的目标 [ 88 ] 。 相关方法在 HybridESM 动态综述中进行了概述 [ 89 ] ；下文我们将重点介绍气候建模联盟（CliMA），因为它为混合气候建模提供了一个全面的范例。

sents.en: The ML-enhanced (MLe) version of ICON-A confirmed the advantages of data-driven equation discovery for parameterization [ 86 ] , provided that the learned parameterization is jointly recalibrated with existing ones, improving agreement with observations of the target process after recalibration [ 87 ] .
sents.zh: ICON-A 的机器学习增强版（MLe）证实了数据驱动方程发现方法在参数化方面的优势 [ 86 ] ，前提是学习得到的参数化方法需与现有参数化方法共同重新校准，这样在校准后就能更好地与目标过程的观测结果一致 [ 87 ] 。

sents.en: Data-driven ocean closures for hybrid modeling now span the full complexity spectrum, including physics-informed and scale-aware models, facilitating the broader goal of coupled atmosphere–ocean–sea-ice hybrid simulations [ 88 ] .
sents.zh: 用于混合建模的数据驱动海洋闭合方法如今已覆盖完整的复杂性谱，包括基于物理和尺度感知的模型，从而促进了大气–海洋–海冰耦合混合模拟这一更广泛的目标 [ 88 ] 。

sents.en: Related approaches are surveyed in the HybridESM living review [ 89 ] ; we henceforth focus on the Climate Modeling Alliance (CliMA) as it provides a comprehensive example of hybrid climate modeling.
sents.zh: 相关方法在 HybridESM 动态综述中进行了概述 [ 89 ] ；下文我们将重点介绍气候建模联盟（CliMA），因为它为混合气候建模提供了一个全面的范例。

paragraphs.en: CliMA combines process-based models that respect physical conservation laws with data-driven components to model the entire Earth system, including atmosphere, oceans, and land. Physical laws and their deductive power provide a scaffolding for out-of-distribution generalizability [ 90 ] , particularly where training data are unavailable to constrain climate projections. This physical framework is augmented with data-driven models to enhance expressiveness, flexibility, and accuracy where sufficient data exist. All model components are designed to be efficient on modern GPU architectures, which enables the large, distributed ensembles required for calibration and uncertainty quantification. This computational strategy allows the model to be trained against observed climate statistics, a method distinct from learning from trajectories of individual weather states, as done in AI weather forecasting, and appropriate for the climate prediction problem [ 76 ] .
paragraphs.zh: CliMA 将遵循物理守恒定律的流程模型与数据驱动组件相结合，以模拟整个地球系统，包括大气层、海洋和陆地。 物理定律及其演绎能力为分布外泛化能力提供了框架 [90]，尤其是在缺乏训练数据来约束气候预测的情况下。 在存在充足数据时，这一物理框架会借助数据驱动模型进行增强，以提升其表达能力、灵活性和准确性。 所有模型组件均设计为能在现代 GPU 架构上高效运行，从而支持校准和不确定性量化所需的大规模分布式集成模型。 这种计算策略使得模型能够基于观测到的气候统计数据进行训练，该方法不同于人工智能天气预报中从单个天气状态轨迹中学习的方式，并且更适用于气候预测问题 [76]。

paragraphs.en: Training the model with climate statistics is primarily accomplished using derivative-free ensemble Kalman methods [ 91 , 92 , 93 ] . These methods approximate stochastic gradient descent through ensembles of simulations and are well-suited for chaotic systems because the ensemble smooths noise-induced extrema in the loss function—extrema that arise from the climate system’s internal variability when the loss to be minimized contains finite-time statistical averages of observables such as cloud cover. Because they require neither adjoints nor differentiability of the forward model, they can be applied to legacy components and to non-differentiable parameterizations, and they reach comparable or lower loss than alternative derivative-free optimizers at a fraction of the cost [ 94 ] . This framework allows learning about small-scale processes, such as turbulent air mass exchange between clouds and their environment, in an inverse problem setting [ 95 , 96 , 90 ] . In this setting, indirect data such as satellite measurements of cloud cover and liquid water path can be used to constrain processes that are not directly observable.
paragraphs.zh: 使用气候统计数据训练模型主要采用无导数系综卡尔曼方法 [ 91 , 92 , 93 ] 。 这些方法通过模拟系综来近似随机梯度下降，非常适合混沌系统，因为系综能够平滑损失函数中由噪声引起的极值——当待最小化的损失包含云量等可观测量的有限时间统计平均时，这些极值会源于气候系统的内部变异性。 由于这些方法既不需要伴随模型，也不要求正向模型具有可微性，因此可以应用于旧有组件和非可微参数化，并且其成本仅为其他无导数优化器的一小部分，同时能达到相当或更低的损失 [ 94 ] 。 该框架使得在反问题设定下能够学习小尺度过程，例如云与其环境之间的湍流气团交换 [ 95 , 96 , 90 ] 。 在此设定中，可以利用卫星测量的云量和液态水路径等间接数据，来约束那些无法直接观测的过程。

paragraphs.en: Calibration alone yields point estimates, but projections require uncertainty quantification of the learned parameters and propagation of these uncertainties into projected climate statistics. CliMA therefore embeds uncertainty quantification in the calibrate–emulate–sample framework [ 97 ] : the ensembles generated during Kalman inversion are reused to train an emulator of the model–data misfit, which is then sampled by Markov chain Monte Carlo to approximate the Bayesian posterior over parameters. This reduces the number of model evaluations needed for posterior sampling by orders of magnitude relative to direct MCMC, making Bayesian uncertainty quantification tractable for global models [ 96 , 98 ] . The resulting posterior ensembles can be propagated forward to obtain distributions of climate statistics of interest, including climate sensitivity. The calibration and uncertainty quantification tools are developed as open-source, model-agnostic packages [ 99 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 仅通过校准只能得到点估计，但预测需要对已学习参数的不确定性进行量化，并将这些不确定性传播到预测的气候统计量中。 因此，CliMA 将不确定性量化嵌入到“校准–模拟–采样”框架中 [97]：在卡尔曼反演过程中生成的集合被重新用于训练模型与数据失配的模拟器，随后通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法对该模拟器进行采样，以近似参数的贝叶斯后验分布。 与直接 MCMC 相比，这种方法将后验采样所需的模型评估次数减少了几个数量级，使得贝叶斯不确定性量化在全球模型中变得可行 [96, 98]。 由此得到的后验集合可以向前传播，以获得所关注的气候统计量的分布，包括气候敏感度。 校准和不确定性量化工具被开发为开源且与模型无关的软件包 [99]。

paragraphs.en: This hybrid methodology is exemplified in the parameterization of turbulence, clouds, and convection, a dominant source of uncertainty in climate projections. Cloud systems respond to temperature and circulation changes, as well as to direct changes in greenhouse gas concentrations that modulate the thermal infrared radiation budget of clouds. In the observational record, the thermal and direct radiative effects are confounded, as temperatures and greenhouse gas concentrations have increased simultaneously. A model must be able to predict these effects separately to be credible in scenarios where they might decouple, such as in geoengineering applications. A purely data-driven model trained on historical data could fail this test. CliMA’s approach uses a physical scaffolding that explicitly models radiative transfer and enforces conservation of mass and energy. Within this framework, AI-based models learn representations for smaller-scale processes, such as the turbulent exchanges between clouds and their environment, which are critical controls on the cloud response to warming but are difficult to model from first principles [ 90 ] . These data-driven small-scale models are often pre-trained offline with computationally generated data, such as libraries of high-resolution large-eddy simulations [ 100 , 101 ] , before being fine-tuned with Earth observations in online, global simulations.
paragraphs.zh: 这种混合方法在湍流、云和対流的参数化中得到了体现，而这些因素是气候预测中不确定性的主要来源。 云系统对温度和环流的变化作出响应，也直接响应温室气体浓度的变化，这些变化会调节云的热红外辐射收支。 在观测记录中，热效应和直接辐射效应相互混淆，因为温度和温室气体浓度同时上升。 一个模型必须能够分别预测这些效应，才能在它们可能解耦的情景（例如地球工程应用）中具有可信度。 一个仅基于历史数据训练的数据驱动模型可能会在这一检验中失败。 CliMA 的方法采用了一种物理框架，该框架明确模拟了辐射传输，并强制质量与能量守恒。 在此框架内，基于人工智能的模型会学习小尺度过程的表示形式，例如云与其环境之间的湍流交换；这些过程是控制云对变暖响应的关键因素，但难以从第一性原理进行建模 [90]。 这些数据驱动的小尺度模型通常先通过计算生成的数据（例如高分辨率大涡模拟库 [100, 101]）进行离线预训练，然后再通过地球观测数据在线进行全球模拟的微调。

paragraphs.en: A different application of the hybrid strategy is used in aspects of land surface modeling. Processes governing snow thickness and albedo are physically complex. However, extensive observational data exist that link snow properties to environmental variables such as temperature, humidity, and precipitation. It is plausible that the variations of these properties and variables in the present climate—across latitudes and altitudes—span the conditions that will occur in a warmer world. This makes data-driven models for snow processes viable. CliMA employs a data-driven snow model, but embeds it within physical guardrails that ensure conservation of water mass and energy [ 102 , 103 ] . The same principle, where data-driven components are constrained by fundamental physics, is applied to other land surface processes, striking a balance between empirical accuracy and physical consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 混合策略的另一种应用体现在地表建模的某些方面。 控制积雪厚度和反照率的过程在物理上十分复杂。 然而，已有大量观测数据将积雪特性与温度、湿度和降水等环境变量联系起来。 在当前气候条件下，这些特性和变量在不同纬度和海拔高度的变化范围，很可能涵盖了未来更温暖世界中将出现的各种情况。 这使得基于数据的积雪过程模型具有可行性。 CliMA 采用了一种基于数据的积雪模型，但将其嵌入物理约束框架中，以确保水质量和能量的守恒 [ 102 , 103 ] 。 同样的原则——即通过基本物理规律对基于数据的组件进行约束——也应用于其他地表过程，从而在经验准确性与物理一致性之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: The hybrid design extends across components. The atmospheric dynamical core conserves air mass, water mass, and moist energy even with subgrid-scale parameterizations active, bounding the closures it hosts [ 65 ] ; ClimaLand couples water, energy, and carbon fluxes through soil, snow, and canopy [ 104 ] ; Oceananigans resolves mesoscale eddies at climate timescales [ 105 ] ; and ClimaCoupler exchanges surface states and fluxes across grids and timesteps. Trainable closures enter wherever unresolved processes dominate uncertainty, while conservation laws constrain the causal structure, facilitating generalization under altered forcing and for counterfactual scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 这种混合设计贯穿各个组件。 大气动力学核心即使在子网格尺度参数化生效的情况下，也能保守空气质量、水质量和湿能，并限制其内部包含的闭合关系 [ 65 ]；ClimaLand 通过土壤、积雪和树冠耦合水、能量和碳通量 [ 104 ]；Oceananigans 能在气候时间尺度上解析中尺度涡旋 [ 105 ]；而 ClimaCoupler 则在不同网格和时间步长之间交换地表状态和通量。 可训练的闭合关系会出现在未解析过程主导不确定性的任何地方，而守恒定律则会约束因果结构，从而促进在强迫条件改变和反事实情景下的泛化能力。
