paragraphs.en: A complementary strategy is to learn most of an Earth system component directly from data. Autoregressive AI weather models cannot necessarily be extended directly to climate timescales. Many models drift from realistic climates or become unstable after several months [ 106 ] . Models trained on reanalysis aim to reproduce the observed climate, its trends, and its variability over the available record, but cannot be expected to generalize automatically to future climate states. Models trained on physically based climate simulations instead aim to emulate a reference model and can be trained across several prescribed climates. At comparable resolution, ACE2 reports approximately 130 × 130\times higher inference throughput than its C96 SHiELD reference model and approximately 700 × 700\times lower energy use per simulated year, estimated from runtime and rated hardware power [ 107 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一种互补的策略是直接从数据中学习地球系统组件的大部分信息。 自回归式人工智能天气模型未必能直接扩展到气候时间尺度。 许多模型在运行几个月后会偏离真实气候或变得不稳定 [ 106 ] 。 基于再分析数据训练的模型旨在重现观测到的气候、其趋势以及可用记录中的变异性，但无法期望它们能自动推广到未来的气候状态。 相反，基于物理气候模拟训练的模型则旨在模拟参考模型，并可以在多个预设气候条件下进行训练。 在分辨率相当的情况下，ACE2 的推理吞吐量约为其 C96 SHiELD 参考模型的 130 × 130\times，而每个模拟年份的能耗则约为后者的 700 × 700\times（根据运行时间和硬件额定功耗估算）[ 107 ] 。

sents.en: A complementary strategy is to learn most of an Earth system component directly from data.
sents.zh: 一种互补的策略是直接从数据中学习地球系统组件的大部分信息。

sents.en: Autoregressive AI weather models cannot necessarily be extended directly to climate timescales.
sents.zh: 自回归式人工智能天气模型未必能直接扩展到气候时间尺度。

sents.en: Many models drift from realistic climates or become unstable after several months [ 106 ] .
sents.zh: 许多模型在运行几个月后会偏离真实气候或变得不稳定 [ 106 ] 。

sents.en: Models trained on reanalysis aim to reproduce the observed climate, its trends, and its variability over the available record, but cannot be expected to generalize automatically to future climate states.
sents.zh: 基于再分析数据训练的模型旨在重现观测到的气候、其趋势以及可用记录中的变异性，但无法期望它们能自动推广到未来的气候状态。

sents.en: Models trained on physically based climate simulations instead aim to emulate a reference model and can be trained across several prescribed climates.
sents.zh: 相反，基于物理气候模拟训练的模型则旨在模拟参考模型，并可以在多个预设气候条件下进行训练。

sents.en: At comparable resolution, ACE2 reports approximately 130 × 130\times higher inference throughput than its C96 SHiELD reference model and approximately 700 × 700\times lower energy use per simulated year, estimated from runtime and rated hardware power [ 107 ] .
sents.zh: 在分辨率相当的情况下，ACE2 的推理吞吐量约为其 C96 SHiELD 参考模型的 130 × 130\times，而每个模拟年份的能耗则约为后者的 700 × 700\times（根据运行时间和硬件额定功耗估算）[ 107 ] 。

paragraphs.en: For example, DLESyM is trained primarily on reanalysis, predicts the atmosphere autoregressively, and includes a simple interactive ocean representation [ 108 ] . ACE [ 109 , 107 ] and CAMulator [ 110 ] have been configured to emulate the atmospheric components of reference climate models. The ACE program has developed a sequence of progressively more demanding atmospheric emulation experiments and is therefore discussed in detail below.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，DLESyM 主要基于再分析数据进行训练，以自回归方式预测大气，并包含一个简单的交互式海洋表示 [ 108 ]。 ACE [ 109 , 107 ] 和 CAMulator [ 110 ] 已被配置为模拟参考气候模型的大气成分。 ACE 项目已经开发了一系列难度逐步提升的大气模拟实验，因此将在下文进行详细讨论。

sents.en: For example, DLESyM is trained primarily on reanalysis, predicts the atmosphere autoregressively, and includes a simple interactive ocean representation [ 108 ] .
sents.zh: 例如，DLESyM 主要基于再分析数据进行训练，以自回归方式预测大气，并包含一个简单的交互式海洋表示 [ 108 ]。

sents.en: ACE [ 109 , 107 ] and CAMulator [ 110 ] have been configured to emulate the atmospheric components of reference climate models.
sents.zh: ACE [ 109 , 107 ] 和 CAMulator [ 110 ] 已被配置为模拟参考气候模型的大气成分。

sents.en: The ACE program has developed a sequence of progressively more demanding atmospheric emulation experiments and is therefore discussed in detail below.
sents.zh: ACE 项目已经开发了一系列难度逐步提升的大气模拟实验，因此将在下文进行详细讨论。

paragraphs.en: The goal of ACE is to emulate a reference global atmospheric model across a range of climates while reproducing its weather variability and climate statistics. The longer-term goal is to extend this approach to the coupled atmosphere–ocean–land–sea-ice system and eventually to other Earth system processes such as biogeochemical cycles. The reference training data must span the forcing combinations over which the emulator is expected to operate.
paragraphs.zh: ACE 的目标是在多种气候条件下模拟参考全球大气模型，同时再现其天气变率和气候统计特征。 更长期的目标是将这种方法扩展到耦合的大气–海洋–陆地–海冰系统，并最终应用于生物地球化学循环等其他地球系统过程。 参考训练数据必须涵盖该模拟器预期运行的所有强迫组合范围。

sents.en: The goal of ACE is to emulate a reference global atmospheric model across a range of climates while reproducing its weather variability and climate statistics.
sents.zh: ACE 的目标是在多种气候条件下模拟参考全球大气模型，同时再现其天气变率和气候统计特征。

sents.en: The longer-term goal is to extend this approach to the coupled atmosphere–ocean–land–sea-ice system and eventually to other Earth system processes such as biogeochemical cycles.
sents.zh: 更长期的目标是将这种方法扩展到耦合的大气–海洋–陆地–海冰系统，并最终应用于生物地球化学循环等其他地球系统过程。

sents.en: The reference training data must span the forcing combinations over which the emulator is expected to operate.
sents.zh: 参考训练数据必须涵盖该模拟器预期运行的所有强迫组合范围。

paragraphs.en: ACE uses NVIDIA’s open-source Spherical Fourier Neural Operator architecture [ 111 ] , typically at approximately 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} horizontal resolution with a 6-hour time step. ACE modifies the standard SFNO architecture to support climate applications and budget calculations. It predicts the surface-flux components needed to calculate atmospheric heat and moisture budgets. It also predicts the atmospheric state in eight terrain-following layers that can be summed into column-integrated heat and moisture without additional vertical interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: ACE 使用了 NVIDIA 的开源球面傅里叶神经算子架构 [111]，通常采用约 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} 的水平分辨率和 6 小时的时间步长。ACE 对标准的 SFNO 架构进行了修改，以支持气候应用和收支计算。它能够预测计算大气热量和水汽收支所需的表面通量分量。此外，它还能预测八个地形跟随层中的大气状态，这些状态可以直接求和得到柱积分的热量和水汽，而无需额外的垂直插值。

paragraphs.en: ACE has been trained to emulate the GFDL/NOAA’s SHiELD model [ 112 ] , a variant of the FV3GFS global weather model, and the atmospheric component of the US Department of Energy’s E3SM [ 113 ] . The first task used a repeating seasonal cycle with prescribed sea-surface temperatures and insolation [ 109 , 114 ] . In these configurations, ACE reproduced the climates of both reference models. Training required approximately 2.5 days on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, and inference produced approximately 800 simulated years per wall-clock day on one A100 GPU.
paragraphs.zh: ACE 经过训练，能够模拟 GFDL/NOAA 的 SHiELD 模型 [ 112 ]（该模型是 FV3GFS 全球天气模型的一个变体）以及美国能源部 E3SM 项目的大气组件 [ 113 ]。 第一个任务使用了一个重复的季节性循环，并设定了固定的海表温度和太阳辐射 [ 109 , 114 ]。 在这些配置中，ACE 再现了两个参考模型的气候特征。 训练过程在四块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上大约需要 2.5 天，而推理过程在一块 A100 GPU 上每实际运行一天可生成约 800 个模拟年份。

sents.en: ACE has been trained to emulate the GFDL/NOAA’s SHiELD model [ 112 ] , a variant of the FV3GFS global weather model, and the atmospheric component of the US Department of Energy’s E3SM [ 113 ] .
sents.zh: ACE 经过训练，能够模拟 GFDL/NOAA 的 SHiELD 模型 [ 112 ]（该模型是 FV3GFS 全球天气模型的一个变体）以及美国能源部 E3SM 项目的大气组件 [ 113 ]。

sents.en: The first task used a repeating seasonal cycle with prescribed sea-surface temperatures and insolation [ 109 , 114 ] .
sents.zh: 第一个任务使用了一个重复的季节性循环，并设定了固定的海表温度和太阳辐射 [ 109 , 114 ]。

sents.en: In these configurations, ACE reproduced the climates of both reference models.
sents.zh: 在这些配置中，ACE 再现了两个参考模型的气候特征。

sents.en: Training required approximately 2.5 days on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs, and inference produced approximately 800 simulated years per wall-clock day on one A100 GPU.
sents.zh: 训练过程在四块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上大约需要 2.5 天，而推理过程在一块 A100 GPU 上每实际运行一天可生成约 800 个模拟年份。

paragraphs.en: The second task was AMIP-style training and testing over the historical period from 1940 to 2020. Century-scale rollouts motivated hard conservation of global dry-air mass and closure of the global atmospheric moisture budget. The resulting ACE2 model reproduces the time-mean climate, global trends, and SST-forced ENSO variability of ERA5 or a reference model [ 107 ] . When trained on ERA5, ACE2 also reproduces statistical characteristics of tropical precipitation variability, including the Madden–Julian Oscillation (Fig. 4 ), and the global spatial distribution of tropical cyclones.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个任务是针对 1940 年至 2020 年历史时期的 AMIP 风格训练和测试。 世纪尺度的模拟促使严格保守全球干空气质量，并确保全球大气水分预算的闭合。 由此得到的 ACE2 模型能够再现 ERA5 或参考模型的时间平均气候、全球趋势以及由海表温度强迫的 ENSO 变异性 [107]。 当在 ERA5 上进行训练时，ACE2 还能再现热带降水变异性的统计特征，包括马登-朱利安振荡（图 4）以及热带气旋的全球空间分布。

sents.en: The second task was AMIP-style training and testing over the historical period from 1940 to 2020.
sents.zh: 第二个任务是针对 1940 年至 2020 年历史时期的 AMIP 风格训练和测试。

sents.en: Century-scale rollouts motivated hard conservation of global dry-air mass and closure of the global atmospheric moisture budget.
sents.zh: 世纪尺度的模拟促使严格保守全球干空气质量，并确保全球大气水分预算的闭合。

sents.en: The resulting ACE2 model reproduces the time-mean climate, global trends, and SST-forced ENSO variability of ERA5 or a reference model [ 107 ] .
sents.zh: 由此得到的 ACE2 模型能够再现 ERA5 或参考模型的时间平均气候、全球趋势以及由海表温度强迫的 ENSO 变异性 [107]。

sents.en: When trained on ERA5, ACE2 also reproduces statistical characteristics of tropical precipitation variability, including the Madden–Julian Oscillation (Fig. 4 ), and the global spatial distribution of tropical cyclones.
sents.zh: 当在 ERA5 上进行训练时，ACE2 还能再现热带降水变异性的统计特征，包括马登-朱利安振荡（图 4）以及热带气旋的全球空间分布。

paragraphs.en: The third task coupled ACE2 to a slab-ocean model and trained the coupled emulator on analogous SHiELD simulations in equilibrium climates with present-day, doubled, and quadrupled CO 2 concentrations [ 115 ] . ACE2-SOM reproduces an unseen intermediate 3 × 3\times CO 2 simulation, providing an example of interpolation between climates used for training. This includes changes in means and extremes. In particular, ACE2-SOM reproduces the extreme-precipitation tail and its sensitivity to 3 × 3\times CO 2 warming more accurately than a coarser ∼ \sim 400 km version of SHiELD (Fig. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第三项任务将 ACE2 与一个平板海洋模型耦合，并利用类似的 SHiELD 模拟对耦合模拟器进行训练，这些模拟涉及当前、二氧化碳浓度加倍和四倍情况下的平衡气候 [ 115 ]。 ACE2-SOM 能够再现一个未见的 3 × 3\times CO 2 中间模拟结果，为训练所用气候之间的插值提供了一个示例。 这包括平均值和极端值的变化。 特别地，ACE2-SOM 对极端降水尾部的再现及其对 3 × 3\times CO 2 增温的敏感性，比 SHiELD 一个分辨率较粗（约 \sim 400 km）的版本更为准确（图 5）。

sents.en: The third task coupled ACE2 to a slab-ocean model and trained the coupled emulator on analogous SHiELD simulations in equilibrium climates with present-day, doubled, and quadrupled CO 2 concentrations [ 115 ] .
sents.zh: 第三项任务将 ACE2 与一个平板海洋模型耦合，并利用类似的 SHiELD 模拟对耦合模拟器进行训练，这些模拟涉及当前、二氧化碳浓度加倍和四倍情况下的平衡气候 [ 115 ]。

sents.en: ACE2-SOM reproduces an unseen intermediate 3 × 3\times CO 2 simulation, providing an example of interpolation between climates used for training.
sents.zh: ACE2-SOM 能够再现一个未见的 3 × 3\times CO 2 中间模拟结果，为训练所用气候之间的插值提供了一个示例。

sents.en: This includes changes in means and extremes.
sents.zh: 这包括平均值和极端值的变化。

sents.en: In particular, ACE2-SOM reproduces the extreme-precipitation tail and its sensitivity to 3 × 3\times CO 2 warming more accurately than a coarser ∼ \sim 400 km version of SHiELD (Fig. 5 ).
sents.zh: 特别地，ACE2-SOM 对极端降水尾部的再现及其对 3 × 3\times CO 2 增温的敏感性，比 SHiELD 一个分辨率较粗（约 \sim 400 km）的版本更为准确（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: OOD tests also exposed limitations in models trained solely on data from AMIP or equilibrium-climate simulations, particularly in disentangling the effects of SST and CO 2 . ACE2-SHiELD forced by observed SST and sea ice, but with CO 2 held constant at the 1979 level, exhibited an unrealistically muted trend in global mean 2-m temperature (Fig. 6 a). In an abrupt 4xCO 2 experiment, the atmosphere of ACE2-SOM adjusted to a 4xCO 2 equilibrium climate within roughly 90 days, breaking global energy conservation and inconsistent with the slower adjustment of its physics-based ocean (Fig. 6 b). ACE2-SOM’s surface-radiative-flux response to changing CO 2 at fixed atmospheric state also differed from a radiation double-call in the reference model. These experiments show that interpolation within AMIP or across equilibrium climates does not ensure the correct response when sea-surface temperature and CO 2 vary independently.
paragraphs.zh: OOD 测试还揭示了仅使用 AMIP 或平衡气候模拟数据训练的模型存在的局限性，尤其是在分离 SST 和 CO₂ 的影响方面。 ACE2-SHiELD 模型以观测到的 SST 和海冰为驱动，但将 CO₂ 恒定在 1979 年的水平，结果显示全球平均 2 米高度温度趋势被不切实际地削弱（图 6a）。 在一个突发的 4xCO₂ 实验中，ACE2-SOM 的大气在大约 90 天内就适应了 4xCO₂ 的平衡气候，这破坏了全球能量守恒，也与其基于物理的海洋系统较慢的调整过程不符（图 6b）。 在大气状态固定的情况下，ACE2-SOM 对 CO₂ 变化的表面辐射通量响应也与参考模型中的辐射双重调用结果不同。 这些实验表明，在 AMIP 内部或跨平衡气候进行插值，并不能确保当海表温度和 CO₂ 独立变化时模型能产生正确的响应。

sents.en: OOD tests also exposed limitations in models trained solely on data from AMIP or equilibrium-climate simulations, particularly in disentangling the effects of SST and CO 2 .
sents.zh: OOD 测试还揭示了仅使用 AMIP 或平衡气候模拟数据训练的模型存在的局限性，尤其是在分离 SST 和 CO₂ 的影响方面。

sents.en: ACE2-SHiELD forced by observed SST and sea ice, but with CO 2 held constant at the 1979 level, exhibited an unrealistically muted trend in global mean 2-m temperature (Fig. 6 a).
sents.zh: ACE2-SHiELD 模型以观测到的 SST 和海冰为驱动，但将 CO₂ 恒定在 1979 年的水平，结果显示全球平均 2 米高度温度趋势被不切实际地削弱（图 6a）。

sents.en: In an abrupt 4xCO 2 experiment, the atmosphere of ACE2-SOM adjusted to a 4xCO 2 equilibrium climate within roughly 90 days, breaking global energy conservation and inconsistent with the slower adjustment of its physics-based ocean (Fig. 6 b).
sents.zh: 在一个突发的 4xCO₂ 实验中，ACE2-SOM 的大气在大约 90 天内就适应了 4xCO₂ 的平衡气候，这破坏了全球能量守恒，也与其基于物理的海洋系统较慢的调整过程不符（图 6b）。

sents.en: ACE2-SOM’s surface-radiative-flux response to changing CO 2 at fixed atmospheric state also differed from a radiation double-call in the reference model.
sents.zh: 在大气状态固定的情况下，ACE2-SOM 对 CO₂ 变化的表面辐射通量响应也与参考模型中的辐射双重调用结果不同。

sents.en: These experiments show that interpolation within AMIP or across equilibrium climates does not ensure the correct response when sea-surface temperature and CO 2 vary independently.
sents.zh: 这些实验表明，在 AMIP 内部或跨平衡气候进行插值，并不能确保当海表温度和 CO₂ 独立变化时模型能产生正确的响应。

paragraphs.en: ACE2S-SHiELD+ addresses this problem by supplementing AMIP and equilibrium-climate simulations with ramped-SST, random-CO 2 simulations, which sample many diverse combinations of SST, atmospheric state, and CO 2 [ 116 ] . It is evaluated on forcing combinations held out from training, including AMIP constant CO 2 (Fig. 6 a), AMIP + 4 +4 K, held-out random-CO 2 trajectories, and slab-ocean abrupt- 4 × 4\times CO 2 (Fig. 6 b) experiments. ACE2S-SHiELD+ retains comparable performance to the earlier ACE2-SHiELD and ACE2-SOM models in their strongest historical AMIP and equilibrium-climate tests, improves the separation of SST-mediated and direct CO 2 responses, and is trained on roughly 25% fewer samples than either alone. Exposing ACE to aerosols or other greenhouse gases as independent forcings would bring it one step closer to conventional climate models.
paragraphs.zh: ACE2S-SHiELD+ 通过用逐步升温的海表温度（ramped-SST）和随机二氧化碳（random-CO₂）模拟来补充 AMIP 和平衡气候模拟，解决了这一问题；这些模拟对海表温度、大气状态和二氧化碳的多种组合进行了采样 [116]。 该模型在训练时未使用的强迫组合上进行了评估，包括 AMIP 恒定二氧化碳（图 6a）、AMIP + 4 +4 K、预留的随机二氧化碳轨迹以及板状海洋突变 4×4×CO₂（图 6b）实验。 ACE2S-SHiELD+ 在历史最强的 AMIP 和平衡气候测试中，保持了与早期 ACE2-SHiELD 和 ACE2-SOM 模型相当的性能；它增强了对海表温度介导的响应与直接二氧化碳响应的区分能力，并且训练样本数量比任一单独模型减少了约 25%。 如果将气溶胶或其他温室气体作为独立强迫因素引入 ACE，它将更接近传统气候模型。

sents.en: ACE2S-SHiELD+ addresses this problem by supplementing AMIP and equilibrium-climate simulations with ramped-SST, random-CO 2 simulations, which sample many diverse combinations of SST, atmospheric state, and CO 2 [ 116 ] .
sents.zh: ACE2S-SHiELD+ 通过用逐步升温的海表温度（ramped-SST）和随机二氧化碳（random-CO₂）模拟来补充 AMIP 和平衡气候模拟，解决了这一问题；这些模拟对海表温度、大气状态和二氧化碳的多种组合进行了采样 [116]。

sents.en: It is evaluated on forcing combinations held out from training, including AMIP constant CO 2 (Fig. 6 a), AMIP + 4 +4 K, held-out random-CO 2 trajectories, and slab-ocean abrupt- 4 × 4\times CO 2 (Fig. 6 b) experiments.
sents.zh: 该模型在训练时未使用的强迫组合上进行了评估，包括 AMIP 恒定二氧化碳（图 6a）、AMIP + 4 +4 K、预留的随机二氧化碳轨迹以及板状海洋突变 4×4×CO₂（图 6b）实验。

sents.en: ACE2S-SHiELD+ retains comparable performance to the earlier ACE2-SHiELD and ACE2-SOM models in their strongest historical AMIP and equilibrium-climate tests, improves the separation of SST-mediated and direct CO 2 responses, and is trained on roughly 25% fewer samples than either alone.
sents.zh: ACE2S-SHiELD+ 在历史最强的 AMIP 和平衡气候测试中，保持了与早期 ACE2-SHiELD 和 ACE2-SOM 模型相当的性能；它增强了对海表温度介导的响应与直接二氧化碳响应的区分能力，并且训练样本数量比任一单独模型减少了约 25%。

sents.en: Exposing ACE to aerosols or other greenhouse gases as independent forcings would bring it one step closer to conventional climate models.
sents.zh: 如果将气溶胶或其他温室气体作为独立强迫因素引入 ACE，它将更接近传统气候模型。

paragraphs.en: A common difficulty for autoregressive atmospheric emulators, related to the fast vs. slow forcings, is that their training loss measures weather prediction over lead times of at most a few days, whereas the relevant evaluation metrics are statistics from multi-year or multidecadal simulations [ 81 ] . Lower short-range forecast error does not guarantee lower climate bias (e.g. Fig. 7 ). One practical approach is to evaluate long climate rollouts during training and select checkpoints using climate statistics rather than short-range loss alone.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归大气模拟器在快速强迫与缓慢强迫之间平衡时，常面临一个难题：其训练损失仅衡量最多数日预报期的天气预测能力，而相关的评估指标却来自多年甚至数十年模拟的统计数据 [ 81 ]。 短期预报误差较低并不一定意味着气候偏差更小（例如，图 7）。 一种可行的方法是在训练过程中对长期气候模拟进行评估，并依据气候统计数据而非仅凭短期损失来选择检查点。

sents.en: A common difficulty for autoregressive atmospheric emulators, related to the fast vs. slow forcings, is that their training loss measures weather prediction over lead times of at most a few days, whereas the relevant evaluation metrics are statistics from multi-year or multidecadal simulations [ 81 ] .
sents.zh: 自回归大气模拟器在快速强迫与缓慢强迫之间平衡时，常面临一个难题：其训练损失仅衡量最多数日预报期的天气预测能力，而相关的评估指标却来自多年甚至数十年模拟的统计数据 [ 81 ]。

sents.en: Lower short-range forecast error does not guarantee lower climate bias (e.g. Fig. 7 ).
sents.zh: 短期预报误差较低并不一定意味着气候偏差更小（例如，图 7）。

sents.en: One practical approach is to evaluate long climate rollouts during training and select checkpoints using climate statistics rather than short-range loss alone.
sents.zh: 一种可行的方法是在训练过程中对长期气候模拟进行评估，并依据气候统计数据而非仅凭短期损失来选择检查点。

paragraphs.en: Amongst all components of the Earth system, ocean representation is particularly important for climate feedbacks because ocean heat uptake, circulation, and carbon storage determine major components of the transient and equilibrium climate response. A surface mixed layer may be sufficient for some idealized atmospheric feedback experiments, but coupled climate projections require representations of ocean circulation, deep-ocean heat uptake, and carbon storage. Learned ocean models have been developed for short-range forecasting, monthly-to-decadal prediction, and multicentury climate emulation.
paragraphs.zh: 在地球系统的所有组成部分中，海洋的模拟对气候反馈尤为重要，因为海洋的热量吸收、环流和碳储存决定了瞬态和平衡气候响应的关键要素。 对于某些理想化的大气反馈实验而言，表层混合层可能已经足够，但耦合气候预测则需要对海洋环流、深层海洋热量吸收和碳储存进行模拟。 基于学习的海洋模型已被用于短期预报、月度至十年期预测以及多世纪的气候模拟。

paragraphs.en: By varying the prognostic variables, depth, horizontal resolution, and time step, data-driven ocean components can target different timescales and processes.
paragraphs.zh: 通过改变预后变量、深度、水平分辨率和时间步长，数据驱动的海洋组件可以针对不同的时间尺度和过程。

paragraphs.en: WenHai [ 117 ] , GLONET [ 118 ] , and FuXi-Ocean [ 119 ] use high-resolution GLORYS or HYCOM reanalysis products to produce ocean forecasts over approximately ten days. WenHai operates at 1 / 12 ∘ 1/12^{\circ} resolution with a one-day time step and represents the upper 643 m. GLONET operates at 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} resolution with a one-day time step and represents the full ocean depth. FuXi-Ocean operates at 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} resolution with a six-hour time step and extends to approximately 1500 m. These models are evaluated against observations following the GODAE OceanView Intercomparison and Validation Task Team Class 4 framework for operational global ocean forecasting systems [ 120 ] .
paragraphs.zh: WenHai [ 117 ]、GLONET [ 118 ] 和 FuXi-Ocean [ 119 ] 使用高分辨率的 GLORYS 或 HYCOM 再分析产品，生成约十天的海洋预报。 WenHai 以 1 / 12 ∘ 1/12^{\circ} 的分辨率和一天的时间步长运行，模拟上层 643 米的海域。 GLONET 以 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} 的分辨率和一天的时间步长运行，模拟整个海洋深度。 FuXi-Ocean 以 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} 的分辨率和六小时的时间步长运行，覆盖约 1500 米的深度。 这些模型根据 GODAE OceanView 互比较与验证任务组第四类框架 [ 120 ]，通过与观测数据的对比进行评估，该框架适用于全球海洋预报业务系统。

paragraphs.en: ORCA-DL targets monthly-to-decadal prediction using monthly time steps [ 121 ] . It is pretrained on CMIP6 simulations and fine-tuned using the Simple Ocean Data Assimilation and Ocean Reanalysis System 5 datasets. ORCA-DL focuses on the upper 300 m, demonstrates skill at lead times of approximately one year, and shows preliminary skill on decadal timescales.
paragraphs.zh: ORCA-DL 以每月为时间步长，针对月度至十年期的预测任务 [ 121 ]。 该模型在 CMIP6 模拟数据上进行了预训练，并使用简单海洋数据同化与海洋再分析系统 5 的数据集进行微调。 ORCA-DL 重点关注上层 300 米海水，在约一年的预测时间范围内展现出预测能力，并在十年期时间尺度上显示出初步的预测效果。

sents.en: ORCA-DL targets monthly-to-decadal prediction using monthly time steps [ 121 ] .
sents.zh: ORCA-DL 以每月为时间步长，针对月度至十年期的预测任务 [ 121 ]。

sents.en: It is pretrained on CMIP6 simulations and fine-tuned using the Simple Ocean Data Assimilation and Ocean Reanalysis System 5 datasets.
sents.zh: 该模型在 CMIP6 模拟数据上进行了预训练，并使用简单海洋数据同化与海洋再分析系统 5 的数据集进行微调。

sents.en: ORCA-DL focuses on the upper 300 m, demonstrates skill at lead times of approximately one year, and shows preliminary skill on decadal timescales.
sents.zh: ORCA-DL 重点关注上层 300 米海水，在约一年的预测时间范围内展现出预测能力，并在十年期时间尺度上显示出初步的预测效果。

paragraphs.en: Samudra targets longer climate integrations by learning from GFDL OM4 simulations a 5-day autoregressive prognostic map, rather than numerically integrating OM4’s governing equations at a 15-min timestep [ 122 ] . Given recent ocean states and prescribed atmospheric surface forcing, it evolves full-depth potential temperature, salinity, horizontal velocity, and sea-surface height, remaining stable in multicentury control-like integrations at approximately 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} resolution. Samudra 2 combines a wider neural architecture with a dynamically reweighted loss to reduce the loss of temporal variability and the leakage of fast velocity patterns into slowly varying deep-ocean fields [ 123 ] . At 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} , it better captures upper-ocean variability and reduces deep-ocean temperature error; 1 / 2 ∘ 1/2^{\circ} and 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} versions support ≈ 8 \approx 8 -year rollouts and recover progressively finer western boundary currents and mesoscale eddies, although deep-ocean variability remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: Samudra 通过从 GFDL OM4 模拟中学习为期 5 天的自回归预测图，而非以 15 分钟的时间步长对 OM4 的控制方程进行数值积分，从而实现了更长时间的气候集成 [ 122 ]。 在给定近期海洋状态和预设的大气表面强迫条件下，它能够演化出全水层的热力温、盐度、水平速度和海平面高度，并在约 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} 分辨率下于持续数世纪的控制性集成中保持稳定。 Samudra 2 将更宽泛的神经网络架构与动态重新加权的损失函数相结合，以减少时间变异性信息的丢失以及快速速度模式向缓慢变化的深层海洋场中的泄漏 [ 123 ]。 在 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} 分辨率下，它能更好地捕捉上层海洋的变异性并减少深层海洋的温度误差；而 1 / 2 ∘ 1/2^{\circ} 和 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} 版本则支持约 8 \approx 8 年的预测模拟，并能逐步恢复更精细的西边界流和中尺度涡旋，尽管深层海洋的变异性仍然具有挑战性。

sents.en: Samudra targets longer climate integrations by learning from GFDL OM4 simulations a 5-day autoregressive prognostic map, rather than numerically integrating OM4’s governing equations at a 15-min timestep [ 122 ] .
sents.zh: Samudra 通过从 GFDL OM4 模拟中学习为期 5 天的自回归预测图，而非以 15 分钟的时间步长对 OM4 的控制方程进行数值积分，从而实现了更长时间的气候集成 [ 122 ]。

sents.zh: 在 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} 分辨率下，它能更好地捕捉上层海洋的变异性并减少深层海洋的温度误差；而 1 / 2 ∘ 1/2^{\circ} 和 1 / 4 ∘ 1/4^{\circ} 版本则支持约 8 \approx 8 年的预测模拟，并能逐步恢复更精细的西边界流和中尺度涡旋，尽管深层海洋的变异性仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Data-driven models need not reproduce the component structure of conventional climate models. A single learned model can represent atmosphere–ocean memory implicitly, as in some subseasonal, seasonal, and decadal prediction systems. Alternatively, independently trained atmosphere and ocean emulators can be coupled through exchanged surface states and fluxes, following the modular structure of conventional climate models. The latter approach permits separate component development and makes the coupling variables explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 数据驱动模型无需再现传统气候模型的组件结构。 单个学习模型可以隐式地表示大气-海洋记忆，正如某些亚季节性、季节性和十年期预测系统中所采用的方式。 另一种方法是，通过交换地表状态和通量来耦合独立训练的大气和海洋模拟器，从而遵循传统气候模型的模块化结构。 后一种方法允许对各个组件进行单独开发，并使耦合变量显性化。

sents.en: Data-driven models need not reproduce the component structure of conventional climate models.
sents.zh: 数据驱动模型无需再现传统气候模型的组件结构。

sents.zh: 单个学习模型可以隐式地表示大气-海洋记忆，正如某些亚季节性、季节性和十年期预测系统中所采用的方式。

sents.en: Alternatively, independently trained atmosphere and ocean emulators can be coupled through exchanged surface states and fluxes, following the modular structure of conventional climate models.
sents.zh: 另一种方法是，通过交换地表状态和通量来耦合独立训练的大气和海洋模拟器，从而遵循传统气候模型的模块化结构。

sents.en: The latter approach permits separate component development and makes the coupling variables explicit.
sents.zh: 后一种方法允许对各个组件进行单独开发，并使耦合变量显性化。

paragraphs.en: SamudrACE couples ACE2 for the atmosphere and land surface with Samudra for the ocean [ 124 , 122 ] . The atmospheric component uses a six-hour time step, while the ocean component uses a five-day time step. The system was trained to emulate a 200-year preindustrial simulation from GFDL CM4 [ 125 ] . Samudra evolves potential temperature, salinity, velocity, and sea-surface height over the full ocean depth. Coupling required the addition of sea-ice variables and consistent land, ocean, and sea-ice fractional coverage across model components.
paragraphs.zh: SamudrACE 将大气和陆地表面的 ACE2 与海洋的 Samudra 耦合 [ 124 , 122 ]。 大气部分的时步为六小时，而海洋部分的时步为五天。 该系统经过训练，以模拟 GFDL CM4 提供的 200 年工业化前模拟结果 [ 125 ]。 Samudra 在整个海洋深度范围内演化潜在温度、盐度、速度和海表面高度。 耦合需要增加海冰变量，并确保模型各部分之间陆地、海洋和海冰的覆盖比例保持一致。

sents.en: SamudrACE couples ACE2 for the atmosphere and land surface with Samudra for the ocean [ 124 , 122 ] .
sents.zh: SamudrACE 将大气和陆地表面的 ACE2 与海洋的 Samudra 耦合 [ 124 , 122 ]。

sents.en: The atmospheric component uses a six-hour time step, while the ocean component uses a five-day time step.
sents.zh: 大气部分的时步为六小时，而海洋部分的时步为五天。

sents.en: The system was trained to emulate a 200-year preindustrial simulation from GFDL CM4 [ 125 ] .
sents.zh: 该系统经过训练，以模拟 GFDL CM4 提供的 200 年工业化前模拟结果 [ 125 ]。

sents.en: Samudra evolves potential temperature, salinity, velocity, and sea-surface height over the full ocean depth.
sents.zh: Samudra 在整个海洋深度范围内演化潜在温度、盐度、速度和海表面高度。

sents.en: Coupling required the addition of sea-ice variables and consistent land, ocean, and sea-ice fractional coverage across model components.
sents.zh: 耦合需要增加海冰变量，并确保模型各部分之间陆地、海洋和海冰的覆盖比例保持一致。

paragraphs.en: SamudrACE produces centuries-long simulations at approximately 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} resolution and runs at roughly 1500 simulated years per wall-clock day on one NVIDIA H100 GPU. It reproduces CM4’s mean climate and generates coupled variability that is absent when boundary conditions are prescribed. Its ENSO variability has a realistic amplitude, although it favors approximately three-year oscillations more strongly than the broader low-frequency spectrum in CM4. Its regression of precipitation on the Niño3.4 index resembles that of CM4, and it reproduces seasonal sea-ice coverage in both hemispheres (Fig. 8 ). In 200-year rollouts, the ocean component also represents multidecadal variability, including decadal variability in the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation.
paragraphs.zh: SamudrACE 以约 1° 的空间分辨率生成持续数百年的模拟结果，在一块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上，其模拟速度约为每墙钟日 1500 个模拟年。 它能够重现 CM4 的平均气候状况，并产生在边界条件被预先设定时所缺失的耦合变异性。 其 ENSO 变异性具有合理的振幅，尽管它比 CM4 中更宽的低频谱更强地倾向于约三年的振荡周期。 其降水与 Niño3.4 指数的回归关系与 CM4 相似，并且能够重现南北半球的季节性海冰覆盖范围（图 8）。 在 200 年的连续模拟中，海洋部分还表现出多十年尺度的变异性，包括大西洋经向翻转环流中的十年尺度变异性。

sents.zh: SamudrACE 以约 1° 的空间分辨率生成持续数百年的模拟结果，在一块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上，其模拟速度约为每墙钟日 1500 个模拟年。

sents.zh: 它能够重现 CM4 的平均气候状况，并产生在边界条件被预先设定时所缺失的耦合变异性。

sents.zh: 其 ENSO 变异性具有合理的振幅，尽管它比 CM4 中更宽的低频谱更强地倾向于约三年的振荡周期。

sents.en: Its regression of precipitation on the Niño3.4 index resembles that of CM4, and it reproduces seasonal sea-ice coverage in both hemispheres (Fig. 8 ).
sents.zh: 其降水与 Niño3.4 指数的回归关系与 CM4 相似，并且能够重现南北半球的季节性海冰覆盖范围（图 8）。

sents.en: In 200-year rollouts, the ocean component also represents multidecadal variability, including decadal variability in the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation.
sents.zh: 在 200 年的连续模拟中，海洋部分还表现出多十年尺度的变异性，包括大西洋经向翻转环流中的十年尺度变异性。

paragraphs.en: The next ongoing task is coupled emulation under changing external forcing. A near-term objective is to reproduce the CMIP DECK experiments—preindustrial control, historical, 1 % ​ yr − 1 1\%~\mathrm{yr}^{-1} CO 2 increase, and abrupt 4 × 4\times CO 2 —together with standard emissions scenarios. The aim is to achieve high fidelity to the reference coupled model using a limited training and validation dataset, for example a few hundred years of reference-model output. If successful, coupled emulators could generate large initial-condition ensembles at less than 1 % 1\% of the computational cost of the corresponding physical-model ensemble.
paragraphs.zh: 下一个持续任务是针对变化外部强迫的耦合模拟。 近期的目标是重现 CMIP DECK 实验——前工业化控制、历史时期、1 % yr⁻¹ CO₂ 增加以及突发的 4 × CO₂——同时包括标准的排放情景。 目标是在有限的训练和验证数据集（例如参考模型数百年的输出）上，实现与参考耦合模型的高度一致。 如果成功，耦合模拟器能够以低于相应物理模型集合 1 % 的计算成本生成大规模初始条件集合。

sents.en: The next ongoing task is coupled emulation under changing external forcing.
sents.zh: 下一个持续任务是针对变化外部强迫的耦合模拟。

sents.en: A near-term objective is to reproduce the CMIP DECK experiments—preindustrial control, historical, 1 % ​ yr − 1 1\%~\mathrm{yr}^{-1} CO 2 increase, and abrupt 4 × 4\times CO 2 —together with standard emissions scenarios.

sents.zh: 目标是在有限的训练和验证数据集（例如参考模型数百年的输出）上，实现与参考耦合模型的高度一致。

sents.en: If successful, coupled emulators could generate large initial-condition ensembles at less than 1 % 1\% of the computational cost of the corresponding physical-model ensemble.
sents.zh: 如果成功，耦合模拟器能够以低于相应物理模型集合 1 % 的计算成本生成大规模初始条件集合。

paragraphs.en: A further option is mixed AI–physics coupling: ACE2-NEMO couples a learned atmosphere emulator to a conventional ocean general circulation model [ 126 ] . Such configurations fall under the broad umbrella of hybrid modeling strategies and could reduce the cost of component calibration. Their generalization under changing climates remains to be tested.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种选择是混合人工智能-物理耦合：ACE2-NEMO 将一种学习到的大气模拟器与传统的海洋环流模式相耦合 [ 126 ]。 此类配置属于混合建模策略的广泛范畴，并可能降低组件校准的成本。 它们在气候变化条件下的泛化能力仍有待检验。

sents.en: A further option is mixed AI–physics coupling: ACE2-NEMO couples a learned atmosphere emulator to a conventional ocean general circulation model [ 126 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种选择是混合人工智能-物理耦合：ACE2-NEMO 将一种学习到的大气模拟器与传统的海洋环流模式相耦合 [ 126 ]。

sents.en: Such configurations fall under the broad umbrella of hybrid modeling strategies and could reduce the cost of component calibration.
sents.zh: 此类配置属于混合建模策略的广泛范畴，并可能降低组件校准的成本。

sents.en: Their generalization under changing climates remains to be tested.
sents.zh: 它们在气候变化条件下的泛化能力仍有待检验。

paragraphs.en: As AI permeates climate modeling, a practical question arises: when do AI-powered models reduce time to solution compared with dynamical models, and what enables that gain?
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能在气候建模中的广泛应用，一个实际问题随之而来：与动力学模型相比，人工智能驱动的模式在何种情况下能够缩短求解时间？又是哪些因素促成了这种效率提升？

paragraphs.en: Time to solution, here defined as the wall-clock time required to complete a satisfactory simulation, limits ensemble size and scenario exploration when large. Yet reported performance is difficult to compare across model families because configurations differ in hardware, precision, scaling regime, prognostic state, effective resolution, and benchmarked tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 解决方案所需时间（此处定义为完成一次满意模拟所需的实际运行时间）在较大时会限制集成规模与场景探索。 然而，由于不同模型系列的配置在硬件、精度、扩展机制、预测状态、有效分辨率和基准测试任务方面存在差异，因此难以对报告的性能进行跨系列比较。

paragraphs.en: While our comparison cannot isolate intrinsic algorithmic efficiency, it shows why raw SYPD comparisons can mislead: Rather than escaping climate-model scaling altogether, AI methods are more readily GPU-ported and act directly on the main factors in Eq. 5 . They can reduce n prog n_{\mathrm{prog}} by predicting only the variables needed for a task, reduce n vert n_{\mathrm{vert}} through compressed vertical representations, increase Δ ​ t \Delta t by not having the numerical stability constraints of dynamical models, or operate at coarser Δ ​ x \Delta x when fine-scale structure is not prognosed explicitly. Thus, much of AI’s time-to-solution gain arises from computing less, and our proxy provides a rough estimate of how reported throughput varies with these choices.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们的比较无法单独区分算法本身的内在效率，但它揭示了为何直接的 SYPD 比较可能会产生误导：AI 方法并非完全摆脱气候模型的缩放问题，而是更容易移植到 GPU 上，并直接作用于公式 5 中的主要因素。 它们可以通过仅预测任务所需的变量来减少 n prog n_{\mathrm{prog}}，通过压缩的垂直表示来减少 n vert n_{\mathrm{vert}}，由于没有动力学模型那样的数值稳定性约束而增加 Δ ​ t \Delta t，或者在无需显式预测精细尺度结构时以更粗的 Δ ​ x \Delta x 运行。 因此，AI 在达到解决方案所需时间上的大部分优势源于计算量的减少，而我们的代理指标为报告的处理量如何随这些选择变化提供了一个粗略的估计。

paragraphs.en: This motivates downscaling: If we target a local hazard variable at high spatiotemporal resolution, the most efficient strategy may not be to prognose the full high-frequency, multivariate climate state at that resolution. A coarse global or regional model can instead provide the large-scale, scenario-dependent prognostic context, while a downscaling strategy such as GenFocal [ 129 ] , Google’s R2-D2 [ 130 ] or HiRO-ACE [ 131 ] reconstructs the high-resolution variables needed for hazard and eventually impacts modeling. In this sense, the strongest scaling advantage of AI may come less from faster full-state integration than from changing what is integrated in time, at what spatial resolution and time step, and what is reconstructed based on needs.
paragraphs.zh: 这推动了降尺度方法的发展：如果我们的目标是高时空分辨率下的局部灾害变量，那么最有效的策略可能并非以该分辨率预测完整的高频多变量气候状态。 相反，一个粗略的全局或区域模型可以提供大尺度的、依赖情景的预测背景，而降尺度策略（如 GenFocal [ 129 ]、谷歌的 R2-D2 [ 130 ] 或 HiRO-ACE [ 131 ]）则能重建灾害乃至影响建模所需的高分辨率变量。 从这个意义上说，AI 最强的降尺度优势可能并非来自更快的完整状态整合，而是来自改变随时间整合的内容、空间分辨率和时间步长，以及根据需求重建哪些变量。

paragraphs.en: Ideally, local hazard assessment would draw directly on samples from the distribution of fields at high spatial and temporal resolution, such as kilometer-scale hourly precipitation, wind, or temperature, conditioned on a forcing scenario 𝒮 {\cal S} . On climate timescales, this requires long simulations and large ensembles, which remain computationally prohibitive for current storm-resolving models [ 132 , 133 ] . Despite emerging prototypes such as cBottle, which generates kilometer-scale atmospheric states conditioned on simplified forcings [ 134 ] , most climate downscaling remains indirectly conditioned on 𝒮 {\cal S} through coarse global climate-model trajectories X GCM , 𝒮 X_{\mathrm{GCM},{\cal S}} :
paragraphs.zh: 理想情况下，局部灾害评估应直接利用高空间和时间分辨率的场分布样本，例如以强迫情景 𝒮 {\cal S} 为条件的公里级每小时降水、风速或温度数据。 在气候时间尺度上，这需要长时间模拟和大规模集成，而这对当前的风暴分辨模型而言计算成本仍然过高 [ 132 , 133 ] 。 尽管已出现一些原型，例如 cBottle，它可以根据简化的强迫条件生成公里级的大气状态 [ 134 ] ，但大多数气候降尺度方法仍通过粗尺度的全球气候模型轨迹 X GCM , 𝒮 X_{\mathrm{GCM},{\cal S}} 间接以 𝒮 {\cal S} 为条件：

paragraphs.en: where p goal p_{\mathrm{goal}} is the desired high-resolution climate distribution, D θ , ϕ D_{\theta,\phi} is the conditional distribution induced by the downscaling procedure, and Z Z denotes auxiliary predictors such as topography or land use. Starting from a scenario-forced GCM, downscaling can follow three broad routes (Fig. 10 ). (1) Dynamical downscaling uses GCM boundary conditions to drive an RCM that explicitly simulates finer-scale regional processes [ 135 ] . (2) Empirical-statistical downscaling (ESD) uses data-driven algorithms to map GCM or RCM fields to higher-resolution observations, reanalyses, or, in some cases, reference-model output [ 136 ] . Because observations provide no ground truth for future climates, observationally trained ESD methods must extrapolate beyond their targets and face OOD limitations, particularly for extremes [ 137 ] . (3) Climate-model emulation for downscaling instead learns from kilometer-scale regional simulations to approximate the mapping from a GCM, or from a coarsened RCM field, to high-resolution RCM output at lower computational cost, but depends on scarce fine-scale simulation targets [ 138 ] . When simulation archives span multiple scenarios, such emulators can be trained and evaluated across climates and rapidly provide local climate projections [ 139 ] . These routes are not mutually exclusive: statistical refinement can follow partial dynamical downscaling [ 140 ] .

sents.en: Starting from a scenario-forced GCM, downscaling can follow three broad routes (Fig. 10 ).
sents.zh: 从情景驱动的 GCM 出发，降尺度方法可以遵循三种主要途径（图 10）。

sents.en: (1) Dynamical downscaling uses GCM boundary conditions to drive an RCM that explicitly simulates finer-scale regional processes [ 135 ] .
sents.zh: （1）动力降尺度利用 GCM 的边界条件来驱动 RCM，从而显式模拟更精细尺度的区域过程 [ 135 ]。

sents.en: (2) Empirical-statistical downscaling (ESD) uses data-driven algorithms to map GCM or RCM fields to higher-resolution observations, reanalyses, or, in some cases, reference-model output [ 136 ] .
sents.zh: （2）经验统计降尺度（ESD）使用数据驱动算法将 GCM 或 RCM 场映射到更高分辨率的观测数据、再分析数据，或在某些情况下，参考模型输出 [ 136 ]。

sents.en: Because observations provide no ground truth for future climates, observationally trained ESD methods must extrapolate beyond their targets and face OOD limitations, particularly for extremes [ 137 ] .
sents.zh: 由于观测数据无法提供未来气候的真实基准，基于观测训练的 ESD 方法必须对其目标范围进行外推，并面临 OOD 限制，尤其是在极端事件方面 [ 137 ]。

sents.en: (3) Climate-model emulation for downscaling instead learns from kilometer-scale regional simulations to approximate the mapping from a GCM, or from a coarsened RCM field, to high-resolution RCM output at lower computational cost, but depends on scarce fine-scale simulation targets [ 138 ] .
sents.zh: （3）用于降尺度的气候模型模拟方法则通过从千米尺度区域模拟中学习，以较低的计算成本近似从 GCM 或经过粗化的 RCM 场到高分辨率 RCM 输出的映射关系，但这种方法依赖于稀缺的精细尺度模拟目标 [ 138 ]。

sents.en: When simulation archives span multiple scenarios, such emulators can be trained and evaluated across climates and rapidly provide local climate projections [ 139 ] .
sents.zh: 当模拟档案涵盖多种情景时，这类模拟器可以在不同气候条件下进行训练和评估，并快速提供局部气候投影 [ 139 ]。

sents.en: These routes are not mutually exclusive: statistical refinement can follow partial dynamical downscaling [ 140 ] .
sents.zh: 这些途径并非互斥：统计优化可以在部分动力降尺度之后进行 [ 140 ]。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in AI-powered downscaling can be organized around three themes: (1) generative modeling, (2) distributional and process-oriented evaluation, and (3) unpaired bias correction.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能驱动的下采样技术的最新进展可围绕三个主题展开：（1）生成式建模，（2）分布与过程导向的评估，以及（3）无配对偏差校正。

paragraphs.en: First, super-resolution illustrates the need for generative modeling. Mapping a coarse field to a corresponding high-resolution field is underdetermined: the coarse field does not uniquely determine the small-scale structures that could have produced it. A deterministic model can estimate a conditional mean or another central tendency, but it cannot represent the range of high-resolution fields compatible with the same coarse input. This limitation is especially important for precipitation, near-surface winds, and other intermittent or spatially heterogeneous variables. Modern super-resolution for climate applications therefore increasingly targets a distribution of high-resolution fields conditioned on low-resolution fields rather than a deterministic reconstruction:
paragraphs.zh: 首先，超分辨率技术说明了生成式建模的必要性。 将粗尺度场映射到对应的高分辨率场是一个欠定的问题：粗尺度场无法唯一地确定可能产生该场的微观结构。 确定性模型可以估计条件均值或其他集中趋势，但无法表示与相同粗尺度输入兼容的高分辨率场的范围。 这种局限性对于降水、近地面风以及其他间歇性或空间异质的变量尤为重要。 因此，现代气候应用中的超分辨率技术越来越多地关注基于低分辨率场的条件化高分辨率场分布，而非确定性重建：

sents.en: First, super-resolution illustrates the need for generative modeling.
sents.zh: 首先，超分辨率技术说明了生成式建模的必要性。

In paired super-resolution of the same variable, the generated high-resolution field is typically required to remain consistent with the coarse field it refines. Hard-constrained downscaling enforces this consistency in the model architecture [ 141 ] . More generally, the coarse predictor and high-resolution target need not be the same variable; such paired mappings belong to the broader “perfect prognosis” family of statistical downscaling methods [ 142 ] . For example, coarse moisture may be more predictive of high-resolution precipitation than coarse precipitation itself.

paragraphs.en: This generative view has changed model design. Diffusion and flow-based models are now prominent in downscaling because they can recover fine-scale spatial and spectral structure while representing multiple plausible outcomes [ 143 ] . Corrective Diffusion (CorrDiff) separates a deterministic prediction from a residual diffusion model that generates fine-scale variability not determined by the coarse input [ 144 ] . Video diffusion extends generative downscaling to spatiotemporal precipitation sequences and can support super-resolution in both space and time [ 145 , 146 ] . Flow matching instead learns a velocity field that transports a reference distribution, such as that of encoded coarse fields, toward the conditional target distribution of e.g., high-resolution fields [ 147 , 148 ] . The same generative logic applies to climate-model emulation, where the target is the conditional variability of a high-resolution dynamical model rather than super-resolved fields [ 149 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这种生成式视角改变了模型设计。 扩散模型和流基模型如今在降尺度方法中占据主导地位，因为它们能够在恢复精细空间与光谱结构的同时，表示出多种合理的输出结果 [ 143 ] 。 校正扩散（CorrDiff）将确定性预测与一个残差扩散模型分离开来，后者负责生成粗输入无法决定的精细尺度变异性 [ 144 ] 。 视频扩散将生成式降尺度扩展到时空降水序列，并支持在空间和时间两个维度上的超分辨率处理 [ 145 , 146 ] 。 流匹配方法则学习一个速度场，该速度场将参考分布（例如编码后的粗场分布）向条件目标分布（例如高分辨率场）进行迁移 [ 147 , 148 ] 。 相同的生成逻辑也适用于气候模型模拟，其中目标并非超分辨率场，而是高分辨率动力学模型的条件变异性 [ 149 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Second, once downscaling is treated generatively, evaluation must go beyond mean error. Recent benchmarks such as CORDEX-ML-Bench show that some AI models can perform comparatively poorly on climatological metrics despite excelling on metrics standard in computer vision [ 150 ] . Consequently, evaluation frameworks now combine computer-vision metrics with tools from statistical downscaling and probabilistic forecasting. Proper scores require both calibration and sharpness of the conditional distribution, while multivariate distributional distances assess whether variables are realistic jointly rather than only marginally. Extreme-value diagnostics assess whether distribution tails are well calibrated, including return levels, high quantiles, and application-derived compound diagnostics such as wildfire risk [ 130 ] . In physical space, object-based metrics assess whether convective cells, fronts, rainbands, or cyclone structures have realistic size, shape, and organization, with recent work approximating these often discontinuous metrics by differentiable surrogates for optimization [ 151 ] . Temporal-coherence metrics test whether generated fields flicker between frames or evolve consistently, while spectral metrics test whether variance is present at the targeted spatial scales, because nominal grid spacing alone can be misleading. Benchmarks increasingly test transfer across regions [ 152 ] , variables, and data products [ 153 ] , adding OOD generalization as a further evaluation requirement. No single metric is sufficient, so diagnostics should be selected for the variable, scale, and application of interest [ 154 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，一旦降尺度处理被视作生成性任务，评估就必须超越平均误差。 近期的基准测试（如 CORDEX-ML-Bench）表明，某些人工智能模型在气候学指标上的表现可能相对较差，尽管它们在计算机视觉的标准指标上表现出色 [ 150 ] 。 因此，当前的评估框架将计算机视觉指标与统计降尺度和概率预测的工具相结合。 适当的评分需要条件分布具备校准性和尖锐性，而多变量分布距离则用于评估变量是否联合具有现实性，而非仅边缘上如此。 极值诊断用于评估分布尾部是否经过良好校准，包括重现水平、高分位数以及源自实际应用的复合诊断指标（如野火风险）[ 130 ] 。 在物理空间上，基于对象的指标用于评估对流单元、锋面、雨带或气旋结构是否具有现实的大小、形状和组织；近期的研究通过可微替代函数来近似这些通常不连续的指标，以实现优化 [ 151 ] 。 时间一致性指标用于检验生成的场在帧与帧之间是否存在闪烁或不一致的变化，而谱指标则用于检验方差是否出现在目标空间尺度上，因为仅凭标称的网格间距可能会产生误导。 基准测试越来越多地检验模型在不同区域 [ 152 ] 、变量和数据产品 [ 153 ] 上的迁移能力，并将域外泛化作为另一项评估要求加入其中。 没有任何单一指标是充分的，因此应根据所关注的变量、尺度和应用来选择相应的诊断方法 [ 154 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Statistical bias correction addressed this problem before the advent of AI-powered downscaling. Multivariate methods move beyond univariate quantile mapping by adjusting dependence across variables or locations [ 155 ] , including through multivariate quantile mapping [ 156 ] , optimal transport [ 157 ] , and rank resampling [ 158 ] . Ensemble corrections use members jointly to correct the target distribution while preserving internal variability [ 159 ] . AI extends these approaches by parameterizing higher-dimensional transfer functions that act on joint spatial, temporal, and multivariate distributions rather than isolated grid points. paragraphs.en: Methods that neglect coarse-predictor bias, or attempt single-step downscaling via super-resolution, can fail when the coarse predictor distribution differs from the observational target distribution [ 160 ] , leading to artifacts when used with future GCM conditions [ 161 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 忽视粗预测器偏差，或试图通过超分辨率实现单步降尺度的方法，在粗预测器的分布与观测目标分布存在差异时可能会失效 [ 160 ]，从而在与未来 GCM 条件结合使用时产生伪影 [ 161 ]。

paragraphs.en: Recent models therefore make the paired–unpaired distinction more explicit. Aich et al. [ 162 ] use a shared latent space to align observational and ESM precipitation fields before training a conditional diffusion model to simultaneously downscale and correct the ESM. GenFocal frames downscaling as high-dimensional distribution matching, separating coarse-scale generative bias correction from super-resolution [ 129 ] . Unpaired AI bias correction nevertheless remains less established than paired AI super-resolution, and its advantage over established statistical methods is not yet clear-cut: statistical correction can better reproduce local marginals, AI can better recover spatial structure, and combining the two can outperform either alone [ 163 ] . Establishing AI’s added value therefore requires comparing joint distributional fidelity, forced-trend preservation, and whether the compute and data requirements justify the skill against strong statistical baselines, ideally across multiple GCM/RCM chains.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，近期的模型更明确地区分了配对与未配对的场景。Aich 等人 [ 162 ] 使用共享的潜在空间来对齐观测数据和 ESM 的降水场，然后在训练条件扩散模型的同时对 ESM 进行降尺度和校正。 GenFocal 将降尺度问题框架化为高维分布匹配，从而将粗尺度的生成性偏差校正与超分辨率处理分离开来 [ 129 ] 。 然而，未配对的 AI 偏差校正相较于配对的 AI 超分辨率仍不够成熟，且其相对于成熟统计方法的优势尚不明确：统计校正能更好地再现局部边缘分布，AI 能更好地恢复空间结构，而将两者结合使用可能比单独使用任一方法效果更佳 [ 163 ] 。 因此，要确立 AI 的附加价值，需要比较其在联合分布保真度、强迫趋势保持方面的表现，并评估其计算和数据需求所带来的技能提升是否足以超越强大的统计基准模型，理想情况下应在多个 GCM/RCM 链中进行验证。

paragraphs.en: For climate applications, the final test is robustness, which can be formalized through well-defined generalization errors [ 164 ] . A downscaling method may perform well in the present climate yet fail for rare extremes absent from training, altered circulation patterns, or future thermodynamic states. Pseudo-reality experiments, also called model-as-truth or perfect-model experiments, provide one way to test this failure mode: high-resolution model output is treated as pseudo-observations, and the downscaler is evaluated on scenarios or extreme values withheld during training [ 165 ] . Robustness should be assessed for the full pipeline, including bias correction and super-resolution, using complementary diagnostics of spectra, temporal coherence, intervariable consistency, and extremes. This is especially important for hazards whose impacts depend on coherent spatiotemporal evolution, such as tropical cyclones, heatwaves, and compound extremes.
paragraphs.zh: 对于气候应用而言，最终测试是稳健性，这可以通过明确定义的泛化误差来形式化 [ 164 ]。 一种降尺度方法可能在当前气候条件下表现良好，但却可能无法应对训练数据中缺失的罕见极端事件、改变后的环流模式或未来的热力学状态。 伪现实实验（也称为模型即真理实验或完美模型实验）提供了一种检验这种失效模式的方法：将高分辨率模型的输出视为伪观测值，并在训练期间保留的场景或极端值上对降尺度模型进行评估 [ 165 ]。 应对整个流程的稳健性进行评估，包括偏差校正和超分辨率，并使用光谱、时间一致性、变量间一致性和极端事件等互补的诊断指标进行分析。 对于其影响依赖于连贯时空演化的灾害（如热带气旋、热浪和复合极端事件），这一点尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: A central open question is how much, and what range of, climate data are needed for reliable extrapolation. CORDEX-ML-Bench shows that AI downscalers trained only on historical conditions can underestimate future climate-change signals, whereas including warmer climates in training improves their representation [ 150 ] . Benchmarks should therefore evaluate complete pipelines under withheld climates and extremes, with particular attention to forced-trend preservation and compute-to-skill tradeoffs, which can differ substantially across generative methods [ 166 ] . Establishing this robustness is essential for decision-making because inexpensive downscaling can generate the large ensembles needed to quantify fine-scale internal variability and the probabilities of rare or potentially unprecedented local hazards [ 167 , 168 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心的开放性问题在于，需要多少气候数据以及何种范围的气候数据，才能实现可靠的预测外推。 CORDEX-ML-Bench 表明，仅基于历史条件训练的 AI 降尺度模型可能会低估未来的气候变化信号，而将更温暖的气候纳入训练则能改善其模拟表现 [ 150 ] 。 因此，基准测试应评估在保留气候和极端事件条件下完整的处理流程，尤其要关注强制趋势的保持以及计算量与技能水平之间的权衡关系，这些方面在不同生成方法之间可能存在显著差异 [ 166 ] 。 建立这种稳健性对决策至关重要，因为成本较低的降尺度方法可以生成大规模集成，从而量化精细尺度的内部变异性以及罕见或可能前所未有的局部灾害发生概率 [ 167 , 168 ] 。

paragraphs.en: AI is already changing operational weather forecasting, but extending these gains to climate-relevant horizons requires more than longer rollouts of weather models. The central challenge is not only to maintain forecast skill, but to produce credible responses to altered forcings, unseen extremes, and counterfactual scenarios. This is not simply a shift from initial-condition to boundary-condition prediction, but a fundamental change in both the modeling problem and the evaluation criteria. AI has accelerated the development of deterministic and probabilistic weather forecasters, subseasonal prediction systems, full climate model emulators, post-processing frameworks, and AI-based downscaling, but none of these systems in isolation resolves the full problem of Earth system prediction across timescales.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能已经在改变业务化天气预报，但要将这些成果扩展到与气候相关的预测时间范围，仅靠延长天气模型的运行时间是不够的。 核心挑战不仅在于维持预报能力，还在于对变化的强迫因素、前所未有的极端事件以及反事实情景生成可信的响应。 这不仅仅是从初始条件预测转向边界条件预测，而是对建模问题和评估标准的双重根本性改变。 人工智能加速了确定性天气预报模型、概率性天气预报模型、亚季节性预测系统、完整气候模型模拟器、后处理框架以及基于人工智能的下尺度方法的开发，但单独来看，这些系统都无法解决跨时间尺度的地球系统预测这一完整问题。

paragraphs.en: To address the OOD nature of climate change prediction, combining AI’s ability to learn from data with the physical structure needed for robust OOD prediction has emerged repeatedly throughout this review, with two main requirements. First, forcing agents such as greenhouse gases, aerosols, land-use change, and more generally perturbations of the hydrological and biogeochemical cycles must be represented explicitly enough for independent manipulation. Second, models must be evaluated for robustness beyond their training distribution, including rare extremes, transient adjustments, and climate shifts. These requirements favor modular combinations of data-driven and physics-based components, with the optimal mix depending on the application of interest.
paragraphs.zh: 为了应对气候变化预测的分布外（OOD）特性，将人工智能从数据中学习的能力与实现稳健的 OOD 预测所需的物理结构相结合，在本综述中反复出现，并提出了两个主要要求。 首先，诸如温室气体、气溶胶、土地利用变化等强迫智能体，以及更广泛的水文和生物地球化学循环扰动，必须得到足够明确的表示，以便能够独立操控。 其次，模型必须在训练分布之外进行稳健性评估，包括罕见极端事件、瞬态调整以及气候转变。 这些要求倾向于采用数据驱动与物理基础组件的模块化组合，而最佳组合则取决于具体的应用需求。

paragraphs.en: Within this broader framework, AI can improve Earth system modeling in four main ways. First, AI can enhance model physics through learned parameterizations of unresolved processes such as clouds and turbulence, trained on observations and high-resolution simulations but embedded within models that retain physical consistency and conservation laws; distilling AI parameterizations additionally promotes process understanding. Second, AI can accelerate discovery through climate model emulators, which approximate expensive models at far lower cost, enabling larger ensembles to explore parameter and scenario uncertainties represented in the training data and making advanced climate information more accessible for scientific and downstream use. Third, AI can make climate projections actionable through statistical downscaling, including super-resolution and hazard-specific risk modeling. Generative models can translate coarse 50–200 km climate information into kilometer-scale fields more efficiently than dynamical downscaling, while combinations of climate output with topography, vegetation, or the built environment can support targeted estimates of hazards such as storm surge and wildfire, improving the associated risk estimation. Fourth, AI can synthesize information across the heterogeneous data streams on which climate science depends, fusing models, satellites, and in-situ observations into products of higher value than any single source, e.g., by combining microwave, laser, and lidar measurements to better constrain liquid and ice water path, which are difficult to observe reliably from a single source.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一更广泛的框架内，人工智能可以通过四种主要方式改进地球系统建模。 首先，人工智能可以通过对未解析过程（如云层和湍流）的学习参数化来增强模型物理特性；这些参数化基于观测数据和高分辨率模拟进行训练，但被嵌入到能够保持物理一致性和守恒定律的模型中；此外，提炼人工智能参数化也有助于加深对这些过程的理解。 其次，人工智能可以通过气候模型模拟器加速发现；这些模拟器能以远低于原模型的成本近似昂贵的气候模型，从而支持更大规模的集成模型来探索训练数据中所体现的参数和情景不确定性，并使高级气候信息更易于在科学及下游应用中获取。 第三，人工智能可以通过统计降尺度方法使气候预测更具可操作性，包括超分辨率降尺度和针对特定灾害的风险建模。 生成式模型能够将粗略的 50–200 公里尺度的气候信息转化为公里尺度的场，其效率高于动力降尺度方法；同时，将气候输出与地形、植被或人工环境相结合，可以支持对风暴潮和野火等灾害的针对性估算，从而提升相关风险估计的准确性。 第四，人工智能能够整合气候科学所依赖的各种异构数据流，将模型、卫星数据和实地观测融合成比任何单一来源更具价值的产品；例如，通过结合微波、激光和激光雷达测量数据，可以更准确地约束液体和冰水路径——这些参数难以通过单一来源可靠地观测到。

sents.en: Within this broader framework, AI can improve Earth system modeling in four main ways.
sents.zh: 在这一更广泛的框架内，人工智能可以通过四种主要方式改进地球系统建模。

sents.en: First, AI can enhance model physics through learned parameterizations of unresolved processes such as clouds and turbulence, trained on observations and high-resolution simulations but embedded within models that retain physical consistency and conservation laws; distilling AI parameterizations additionally promotes process understanding.
sents.zh: 首先，人工智能可以通过对未解析过程（如云层和湍流）的学习参数化来增强模型物理特性；这些参数化基于观测数据和高分辨率模拟进行训练，但被嵌入到能够保持物理一致性和守恒定律的模型中；此外，提炼人工智能参数化也有助于加深对这些过程的理解。

sents.en: Second, AI can accelerate discovery through climate model emulators, which approximate expensive models at far lower cost, enabling larger ensembles to explore parameter and scenario uncertainties represented in the training data and making advanced climate information more accessible for scientific and downstream use.
sents.zh: 其次，人工智能可以通过气候模型模拟器加速发现；这些模拟器能以远低于原模型的成本近似昂贵的气候模型，从而支持更大规模的集成模型来探索训练数据中所体现的参数和情景不确定性，并使高级气候信息更易于在科学及下游应用中获取。

sents.en: Third, AI can make climate projections actionable through statistical downscaling, including super-resolution and hazard-specific risk modeling.
sents.zh: 第三，人工智能可以通过统计降尺度方法使气候预测更具可操作性，包括超分辨率降尺度和针对特定灾害的风险建模。

sents.en: Generative models can translate coarse 50–200 km climate information into kilometer-scale fields more efficiently than dynamical downscaling, while combinations of climate output with topography, vegetation, or the built environment can support targeted estimates of hazards such as storm surge and wildfire, improving the associated risk estimation.
sents.zh: 生成式模型能够将粗略的 50–200 公里尺度的气候信息转化为公里尺度的场，其效率高于动力降尺度方法；同时，将气候输出与地形、植被或人工环境相结合，可以支持对风暴潮和野火等灾害的针对性估算，从而提升相关风险估计的准确性。

sents.en: Fourth, AI can synthesize information across the heterogeneous data streams on which climate science depends, fusing models, satellites, and in-situ observations into products of higher value than any single source, e.g., by combining microwave, laser, and lidar measurements to better constrain liquid and ice water path, which are difficult to observe reliably from a single source.
sents.zh: 第四，人工智能能够整合气候科学所依赖的各种异构数据流，将模型、卫星数据和实地观测融合成比任何单一来源更具价值的产品；例如，通过结合微波、激光和激光雷达测量数据，可以更准确地约束液体和冰水路径——这些参数难以通过单一来源可靠地观测到。

paragraphs.en: These roles are synergistic. Better fused and downscaled data provide stronger targets for learned parameterizations, improved physics increases the realism and value of fast emulators, and all three improve the quality of actionable climate information. As comparing AI against optimized GPU-ported models highlights that AI reduces the time-to-solution by computing less (timesteps, prognostic variables, levels, etc.), its greatest promise may therefore lie in complementing and reorganizing the use of physics-based models through the accelerated model development cycle AI allows. This naturally points toward an Earth system modeling enterprise built from transparent combinations of learned and physically-based components, with different models specializing by regime, process, task, and scale, with the caveat that this may complicate the AI design and training process required to obtain optimal results. Coding the physically-based components in an ML-differentiable language is key for optimizing this training across the full modeling system [ 169 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些角色具有协同效应。 融合和降尺度处理得更好的数据为学习到的参数化提供了更强大的目标，改进的物理模型提升了快速模拟器的真实性和价值，而这三者共同改善了可行动气候信息的品质。 正如将人工智能与经过优化的 GPU 移植模型进行比较所揭示的那样，人工智能通过减少计算量（时间步长、预测变量、层级等）缩短了求解时间，因此其最大的潜力可能在于，借助人工智能所实现的加速模型开发周期，对基于物理的模型的使用进行补充和重组。 这自然指向了一种地球系统建模方案：该方案由学习组件和基于物理的组件以透明的方式组合而成，不同模型分别针对不同的机制、过程、任务和尺度进行专业化；但需要指出的是，这可能会使获得最佳结果所需的人工智能设计和训练过程变得更加复杂。 将基于物理的组件用机器学习可微分的语言编写，是优化整个建模系统训练的关键 [ 169 ] 。

sents.zh: 这些角色具有协同效应。

paragraphs.en: Near-term progress in Earth system AI may be driven by improved weather and climate data infrastructures, especially around ERA6 and CMIP7. On the weather side, improved reanalyses, higher spatial resolution, better stratospheric representation, stronger ocean–atmosphere coupling [ 170 ] , and continued advances in physics and data assimilation should strengthen the training signal available to AI systems and improve their handling of extremes. On the climate side, CMIP7-related efforts will expand the space of scenarios, attribution experiments, and likely emissions-driven simulations, providing a richer basis for learning and testing forced responses, counterfactual climates, and process-level interactions involving the four CMIP7 challenges: SST patterns, weather extremes, carbon–water coupling, and possible tipping behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 地球系统人工智能的近期进展可能得益于天气和气候数据基础设施的改进，尤其是在 ERA6 和 CMIP7 方面。 在天气领域，改进的重分析数据、更高的空间分辨率、更精确的对流层表现、更强的海洋-大气耦合 [ 170 ]，以及物理模型和数据同化技术的持续进步，应能增强人工智能系统可用的训练信号，并提升其对极端天气事件的处理能力。 在气候领域，与 CMIP7 相关的努力将拓展情景空间、归因实验以及可能由排放驱动的模拟范围，从而为学习受强迫响应的机制、反事实气候，以及涉及 CMIP7 四大挑战（SST 模式、极端天气事件、碳-水耦合和潜在的临界点行为）的过程层面相互作用提供更丰富的基础。

paragraphs.en: Given that AI is democratizing modeling, the future of Earth system AI may not be dominated by a single foundation model, but rather evolve towards an ecosystem of specialized, mixable, complementary models whose domains of validity would ideally be explicit. On the weather side, models may specialize by region, dynamical regime, loss function, or observing system, for example separating components optimized for bulk skill from those optimized for extremes, or remote-sensing-informed models from reanalysis-informed ones. On the climate side, models may specialize by Earth system process, diagnostic task, bias-correction role, domain of validity, or data source, e.g., distinguishing components trained on fused observations from those trained as emulators of physically-based simulations. A successful example is the parameterization mixing framework recently introduced in the ICON-A-MLe hybrid model, where a conventional convection parameterization is mixed with an AI parameterization based on its learned confidence [ 171 ] , also demonstrating inter-model transferability as the AI parameterization was trained on E3SM data.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于人工智能正在推动建模技术的普及，地球系统人工智能的未来可能不再由单一的基础模型主导，而是会演变为一个由专业、可混合且互补的模型组成的生态系统，这些模型的理想状态是明确界定其有效范围。 在天气领域，模型可以按区域、动力机制、损失函数或观测系统进行专业化，例如将针对整体技能优化的组件与针对极端事件优化的组件分离，或将基于遥感信息的模型与基于再分析数据的模型区分开来。 在气候领域，模型可以按地球系统过程、诊断任务、偏差校正作用、有效范围或数据源进行专业化，例如区分基于融合观测数据训练的组件与作为物理模拟仿真模拟器的训练组件。 一个成功的案例是最近引入 ICON-A-MLe 混合模型的参数化混合框架，其中将传统的对流参数化与基于其学习置信度的人工智能参数化进行混合 [171]，同时该框架也展示了模型间的可迁移性，因为人工智能参数化是基于 E3SM 数据训练的。

paragraphs.en: Model ecosystems support ensembles by allowing uncertainty to arise not only from generative modeling or stochastic sampling of weights and training data, but also from structural diversity across models. They support data fusion by allowing models trained on different observational products and reference simulations to contribute where they are most informative. They support hazard-specific prediction through task-aware models for extremes and impact-related variables. They also create room for creativity in model design, because Earth system AI need not inherit the structure of legacy forecast systems if more direct formulations and decompositions better match the target process, the available data, or the prediction horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 模型生态系统通过允许不确定性不仅源于生成式建模或权重的随机采样和训练数据，还源于模型之间的结构多样性，从而支持集成模型。 它们通过允许基于不同观测产品和参考模拟训练的模型在各自最具信息价值的领域做出贡献，从而支持数据融合。 它们通过针对极端事件和影响相关变量的任务感知模型，支持特定灾害的预测。 它们也为模型设计创造了创新空间，因为如果更直接的公式和分解方式能更好地匹配目标过程、可用数据或预测时间范围，地球系统人工智能就不必继承传统预报系统的结构。

sents.zh: 它们也为模型设计创造了创新空间，因为如果更直接的公式和分解方式能更好地匹配目标过程、可用数据或预测时间范围，地球系统人工智能就不必继承传统预报系统的结构。

paragraphs.en: Such diversity increases the burden of evaluation and maintenance, and credibility may therefore concentrate around a smaller number of well-maintained “anchor models,” while more specialized models address narrower tasks. At the same time, AI climate emulators and hybrid AI–physics models may converge toward a broader ecosystem of transparent hybrid systems, combining learned and physically based components differently across applications. For such an ecosystem to remain credible, each component should ideally declare the data on which it was trained, its optimization objective, its sample-wise skill and uncertainty, and its training and inference cost. This is not only a practical requirement for benchmarking; it is also a sustainability requirement for deciding whether a model’s added value is worth the negative environmental impact associated with training and inference, and a scientific requirement for understanding a model’s trustworthiness. The central tension is therefore between the proliferation coming from lower development barriers and the consolidation around models that are flexible, transparent, and trusted. If managed successfully, this ecosystem could combine dynamical understanding, observations, simulations, and task-specific learning into more adaptive and testable prediction systems.
paragraphs.zh: 这种多样性增加了评估和维护的负担，因此可信度可能会集中在少数维护良好的“锚定模型”上，而更专业的模型则用于解决更狭窄的任务。 与此同时，人工智能气候模拟器和混合人工智能-物理模型可能会汇聚成一个更广泛的透明混合系统生态系统，在不同应用中以不同方式结合学习到的组件和基于物理的组件。 为了使这样的生态系统保持可信，每个组件理想情况下都应声明其训练数据、优化目标、样本级的技能与不确定性，以及训练和推理成本。 这不仅是基准测试的实际要求，也是判断模型附加价值是否值得与其训练和推理相关的负面环境影响的可持续性要求，同时也是理解模型可靠性的科学要求。 因此，核心矛盾在于：一方面，较低的开发门槛导致模型数量激增；另一方面，系统又倾向于向灵活、透明且受信任的模型集中。 如果管理得当，这个生态系统能够将动态理解、观测、模拟和特定任务的学习结合起来，形成更具适应性和可测试性的预测系统。

sents.zh: 如果管理得当，这个生态系统能够将动态理解、观测、模拟和特定任务的学习结合起来，形成更具适应性和可测试性的预测系统。

paragraphs.en: We used large language models (LLMs) for language editing only, specifically to assist in converting point form notes from multi-author discussions to paragraphs form, in reducing manuscript length from the original draft and in improving syntax and readability. No scientific data or figure was generated by LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅将大型语言模型（LLM）用于语言编辑，具体而言，是协助将多位作者讨论中的要点式笔记转化为段落形式，缩短手稿相较于初稿的长度，并改善句法与可读性。 LLM 并未生成任何科学数据或图表。
